title: Digital marketing professional – ready to build a brand of your own?
description: **I'm looking for a new entrepreneur and owner for Anna aikaa.**What if, instead of giving more things, we gave more time, well-being and meaningful experiences?This is the idea behind Anna aikaa (Finnish for "Give Time") – a digital gift card marketplace whose first service category is modern, dry-steam home cleaning.Through the platform, customers can give their loved ones the gift of an easier everyday life, while local cleaning entrepreneurs deliver the services.But why stop at cleaning?Anna aikaa has the potential to become a nationwide marketplace for experience and service-based gifts. Beauty treatments, wellness services, experiences, everyday assistance and unforgettable moments. The possibilities are endless.**The foundation is built. Now it needs someone who sees its potential.**What will you acquire?- An established brand and visual identity. - A digital gift card marketplace and its underlying technology. - An integrated payment and automated gift card system. - First cleaning service providers in existing network - A scalable, commission-based business model. - Full onboarding and ongoing collaboration with a cleaning industry specialist. The business does not require physical premises, inventory or its own service delivery staff. It can be operated remotely from anywhere.Who is this opportunity for?Someone who understands digital marketing, social media and consumer behaviour. Someone who knows how to create engaging content, connect with people emotionally and turn visibility into sales.Perhaps you have spent your career growing other people's brands and are now ready to build your own.You do not need any professional experience in the cleaning industry. I will remain a business partner, providing training and equipment solutions for new cleaning service providers joining the network. You can focus on growing the business and developing new service categories.Why am I looking for a new owner?My professional focus is shifting towards cleaning industry expertise, training and equipment sales. I want to find someone with the marketing skills, vision and ambition that Anna aikaa needs to reach its full potential.This is an opportunity to acquire an early-stage digital business and become an independent entrepreneur. It is not a salaried position or a franchise agreement.**If you recognise yourself in this description and see an opportunity to build something significant on a national scale, I would love to hear from you.**Discover the platform: www.annaaikaa.fiGet in touch and tell me a little about yourself, your expertise and your vision for the future of Anna aikaa.

title: HYPOXI-ohjaaja, Liikunta-ohjaaja
description: HYPOXI on luonnollinen menetelmä, jossa yhdistyvät kevyt liikunta ja alipaine. Sen avulla rasvanpolttoa voidaan kohdistaa kehon niin sanotuille ongelma-alueille. Studiollamme asiakkaat eivät jää yksin, paikalla on aina HYPOXI-ohjaaja.Nyt etsimme Turun studiolle osa-aikaista studio-ohjaajaa.Työ sijoittuu pääasiassa iltapäivään ja iltaan, ja tunteja kertyy noin 50-90 h/kk.Miltä työpäiväsi voi näyttää?- Otat asiakkaat vastaan ja luot heille tervetulleen fiiliksen - Ohjaat ja opastat HYPOXI-laitteiden käytössä - Huolehdit ajanvarauksista ja sujuvasta arjesta studiolla - Pidät yhteyttä asiakkaisiin puhelimitse ja sähköpostilla Voisit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:- Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja hyvä asiakaskokemus on sinulle tärkeää - Sinulla on kiinnostusta liikuntaan, hyvinvointiin ja terveellisiin elämäntapoihin - Olet energinen, ulospäinsuuntautunut ja tulet toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa - Pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja ottamaan vastuuta - Voit laskuttaa työsi (esim. kevytyrittäjänä tai oman yrityksen kautta) Et tarvitse valmista HYPOXI-osaamista me koulutamme sinut tehtävään. Liikunta-, ravinto- tai terveysalan tausta on plussaa, mutta ei pakollinen.Plussaa, jos olet jo hyvinvointialalla: Jos työskentelet esimerkiksi hierojana, voit yhdistää tämän työn nykyiseen työhösi. Meillä on mahdollisuus tarjota tiloistamme huone myös omaa asiakastyötäsi varten.Kuulostaako sinulta? Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus (kerrothan siinä itsestäsi, taustastasi ja miksi kiinnostuit) osoitteeseen riina@hypoxi.fi. Otsikoksi: HYPOXI-ohjaaja TURKU

title: Suuhygienisti, Suun terveydenhuolto, Kaarina
description: Meillä Varhalla pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kehittymismyönteistä työyhteisöä, jossa arvostamme osaamistasi ja tuemme ammatillista kasvuasi. Tule mukaan!TehtäväsiSuuhygienistinä työskentelet itsenäisesti suun terveyden edistämisen ja hoidon parissa. Toimit oman alasi asiantuntijana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suun terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja opiskelijoiden käytännön harjoittelun ohjaamista.Pääasiallinen työpisteesi sijaitsee Kaarinan suun terveydenhuollossa, mutta työskentelet tarvittaessa myös Varhan muilla vastaanotoilla. Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Tuotevirhekoordinaattori
description: Koordinaattorin tehtäviin kuuluu tuotevirheprosessin koordinointi ja avustaminen sekä sen mahdollistamalta osalta muut tiimin tehtävät: Tuotevirheilmoitusten sekä GMP- ja GDP-non-compliance-ilmoitusten koordinointi, sisältäen mm. rekisteröinnin, jatkokäsittelyn ja asiantuntijoille ohjaamisen, tuotevirheiden käsittelyyn liittyvien kokousten järjestelyt sekä asiointipostilaatikon päivystyksen virka-aikaan Tuotevirheprosessiin liittyvä ohjaus ja neuvonta Tuotevirhetilastoinnin esivalmistelu Verkkosivujen ylläpitoon osallistuminen Säädösten, määräysten ja ohjeiden valmistelu ja kommentointiin osallistuminen Ammattitaidon jatkuva ylläpitäminen ja toiminnan kehittäminenFimeassa on valmisteilla organisaatiomuutos, jonka myötä koordinaattorin tehtävänkuva saattaa laajentua.Toteutamme rekrytoinnin anonyymisti edistääksemme yhdenmukaista ja tasa-arvoista rekrytointia. Valitsemme hakijat haastatteluun ilman tietoa hakijan nimestä, iästä, sukupuolesta, paikkakunnasta (kaikki yhteystiedot), äidinkielestä, kansallisuudesta tai hakijan ulkonäöstä. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin vuoksi toivomme hakemukset ensisijaisesti sähköisessä muodossa valtiolle.fi kautta. Vältäthän myös henkilötietojesi kirjaamista hakemuksen avoimissa tekstikentissä. Mikäli kysyt puhelimitse lisätietoja tehtävästä, vältäthän kertomasta itsestäsi tietoja, jotka vaarantavat anonyymiyden. Emme vastaanota liitetiedostoja.

title: Projektipäällikkö, korjausrakentaminen
description: Oletko kokenut korjausrakentamisen asiantuntija ja mietit uusia uramahdollisuuksia? Etsimme nyt Ouluun vakituiseen työsuhteeseen projektipäällikköä vaativiin korjausrakentamisen hankkeisiin. Mitä tehtävä sisältää? Projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa omien vahvuuksiesi ja osaamisesi mukaisessa roolissa. Taustastasi riippuen tehtäväsi painottuvat esimerkiksi rakennusteknisiin tutkimuksiin, rakennesuunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Sinun ei siis tarvitse olla kaikkien osa-alueiden asiantuntija, vaan tehtävänkuvaa rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta. Toimit asiakkaidemme asiantuntijana ja vastaat oman roolisi mukaisesti hankkeiden koordinoinnista ja ohjauksesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä yli toimialarajojemme, asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että hankkeet etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulun, kustannusten ja määräysten mukaisesti. Kulttuurimme kulmakiviä on tutkitusti ystävällinen työyhteisö ja matala hierarkia. Toimit osana monialaista korjausrakentamisen tiimiä, josta saat työkavereiksesi eri alojen asiantuntijoita. Vahva paikallinen yhteishenki ja tekeminen yhdistettynä valtakunnalliseen yhteistyöhön eri toimistojemme välillä tuo toimintaamme ketteryyttä, jota nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissakin tarvitaan. Päätökset teemme siellä, missä se on nopeinta ja kulloinkin järkevintä – tiimit on asetettu meillä päätöksenteon keskiöön. Talon sisäinen yhteistyö ja osaamisen jakaminen mahdollistavat sinulle pääsyn myös muiden alueiden hankkeisiin. Oulun toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella keskustan kupeessa, jossa meillä on modernit toimisto- ja neuvottelutilat sekä viihtyisät taukotilat. Työsi on liikkuvaa ja kohteet sijaitsevat Pohjois-Suomessa, pääosin Oulun seudulla. Avaimia tehtävässä menestymiseen Odotamme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vaativista korjausrakentamisen hankkeista sekä näyttöjä onnistuneesta asiakastyöstä. Sinulla on kokemusta pitkäjänteisestä yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden kanssa ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä tunnistaa asiakkaiden tulevia tarpeita. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, kuten rakennustekniikan insinöörin (AMK/YAMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Kokemuksesi painottuu kiinteistöihin ja voi painottua esimerkiksi tutkimukseen, suunnitteluun, projektinjohtoon, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Tärkeintä on vahva osaaminen omalla alueellasi sekä kokemus vastuullisesta roolista korjaushankkeissa. Arvostamme kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia ja viedä hankkeita tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa. Arvostamme myös RTA-, RAP-, RAV- tai KHK-pätevyyksiä. Meille on tärkeää asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työskentelytapa. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja vastuullinen ammattilainen, joka kuuntelee muita ja tuo samalla rohkeasti esiin omat näkemyksensä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää osaamistasi ja jakaa sitä myös muiden kanssa. Mitä lupaamme sinulle - Transforming society together. Swecolla olet mukana luomassa tulevaisuuden kaupunkeja ja kestävämpää yhteiskuntaa – olet oikeasti vaikuttamassa.- Maailma avoinna. Swecolaisia on yhteensä 23 000 ympäri Euroopan, ja Suomessa meitä on 28 paikkakunnalla 3 300 henkeä. Kansainvälinen ja laaja organisaatiomme tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia työskennellä eurooppalaisten kollegojen kanssa – tai vaihtaa toimipistettä Suomessa elämäntilanteesi mukaan.- Oma urapolku ja koulutusmahdollisuudet. Meille on tärkeää, että pääset kehittymään ja suunnittelemaan omannäköistä urapolkua ja tässä me kuuntelemme sinua. Monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia sinulle tarjoaa oma Sweco Akatemiamme - Monipuolinen ja kattava henkilöstöetukokonaisuus, jonka sisältöön pystyt itse vaikuttamaan. - Työnantajana olemme joustava, ja työsi ja yksityiselämäsi kestävä yhteensovittaminen on meille prioriteetti. Haluatko tutustua vielä tarkemmin työkulttuuriimme? Sehän onnistuu täällä: https://www.sweco.fi/ura/tyontekijalupaus/ Tulisitko työkaveriksemme? Tähän tehtävään voit hakea oheisen linkin kautta maanantaihin 30.11.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja tapaamme tehtävästä kiinnostuneita jo hakuaikana, joten ethän suotta odottele viime hetkeen asti. Mikäli mielessäsi on kysymyksiä tehtävään tai meillä työskentelyyn liittyen, tiimipäällikkö Anssi Pöllänen juttelee mielellään kanssasi lisää. Anssin tavoitat numerosta 040 596 2740 tai sähköpostitse anssi.pollanen(a)sweco.fi. Huom! Rekrytointijärjestelmämme on huoltokatkon vuoksi poissa käytöstä pe 20.11. klo 22.00 alkaen ma 23.11. klo 01.00 asti. Huoltokatkon aikana hakemuksia ei voi jättää. Ennen huoltokatkoa avatut rekrytoinnit, joiden hakuaika on edelleen käynnissä, avautuvat jälleen huoltokatkon päätyttyä ja niihin voi jättää hakemuksen normaalisti. Pahoittelemme huoltokatkosta mahdollisesti aiheutuvaa haittaa.Paikkakunnat: Oulu

title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor
description:
Were seeking a Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor for our client.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Background:
Our client is planning a modernization of its production data and industrial IT architecture. The current environment consists of multiple systems, some of which are approaching end-of-life and require replacement or consolidation. The client has already reviewed several vendor solutions and is now looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to act as an independent, neutral advisor and sparring partner during the assessment and design phase. The consultant will help evaluate the current landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, and support decision-making regarding future architecture, technology choices, and vendor ecosystem. The objective is a more standardized and controlled architecture that supports operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and future AI capabilities.

Responsibilities:
· Assess the current application and architecture landscape.
· Provide independent recommendations on future-state architecture and modernization options.
· Support decision-making related to technology platforms, vendors, and long-term architecture direction.
· Help define the problems to be solved and what the new architecture needs to achieve.
· Facilitate architecture discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
· Help define architectural principles, priorities, and transformation roadmap.
· Identify opportunities to improve data utilization and prepare the environment for future AI-driven initiatives.
· Bring lessons learned from similar industrial transformation programs.

Requirements:
· Experience with production data and industrial IT architecture.
· Experience as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, including evaluating technology and vendor options neutrally and challenging proposals.
· Proven track record in large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, or process industry environments, with references from similar projects.
· Experience with complex enterprise application landscapes, including replacing legacy systems and consolidating them.
· Strong understanding of industrial data ecosystems and IT architecture.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have senior experience as an Enterprise Architect, IT Architect, or in a similar senior advisory role in oil and gas, energy, or another process or heavy industry?*
- Have you led or advised on the replacement of legacy systems and the consolidation of a complex production data or industrial IT landscape?*
- Have you acted as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, evaluating technology or vendor options neutrally?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Language: Professional working proficiency in English.
Start date: November / December 2026
Duration: TBC, project to be completed be the end of Q1
Allocation: 50-100 %
Location: Espoo, Finland. Consultant should be ready to come onsite in the beginning of the assignment, after that remote work is possible.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

You can also find us on Facebook and Instagram.

title: Suksivuokraamotyöntekijä, asiakaspalvelija
description: Suksivuokraamon työntekijöitä – Peuramaa Ski, Kirkkonummi**Tykkäätkö vauhdista, talvesta ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä? Tule Peuramaalle töihin!**Peuramaa Ski etsii nyt reippaita, oma-aloitteisia ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä työntekijöitä suksivuokraamoonsa talvikaudelle 2026–2027.Vuokraamossamme pääset työskentelemään keskellä laskettelukeskuksen toimintaa. Päivät ovat vaihtelevia, asiakkaita riittää ja tekemistä löytyy!**Meille tärkeintä ovat reipas asenne, ripeys ja halu tehdä töitä. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi!**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?Suksivuokraamossa huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaat saavat sopivat ja turvallisesti käyttöön valmistellut lasketteluvälineet mahdollisimman sujuvasti.Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:- Laskettelu- ja lumilautavälineiden vuokraaminen - Asiakaspalvelu ja kassatyöskentely - Asiakkaiden auttaminen oikeiden välineiden valinnassa - Monojen, suksien ja lumilautojen käsittely - Välineiden säätäminen ja huoltaminen perehdytyksen mukaisesti - Vuokraamon järjestyksestä ja päivittäisestä toiminnasta huolehtiminen Mitä odotamme sinulta?- Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta - Ripeää ja tehokasta työskentelyotetta - Hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja - Oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullisuutta - Kykyä toimia kiireisessä ympäristössä - Valmiutta ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön - Halua oppia uusia asioita Laskettelun ja lumilautailun tuntemus on etu, mutta aikaisempi kokemus suksivuokraamosta ei ole välttämätöntä.**Arvostamme erityisesti työntekijöitä, jotka tarttuvat toimeen, auttavat työkavereitaan ja pitävät homman liikkeessä myös kiireisimpinä hetkinä.**Mitä tarjoamme?- Vauhdikkaan ja mukavan työympäristön laskettelukeskuksessa - Monipuolisia ja aktiivisia työtehtäviä - Mukavan työporukan - Perehdytyksen tehtäviin ja välineisiin - Mahdollisuuden työskennellä talvikauden ajan - Työvuoroja pääasiassa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin Työsuhteen tiedot**Työpaikka:** Peuramaa Ski, Peuramaantie 116, Kirkkonummi**Työsuhde:** Määräaikainen kausityö, talvikausi 2026–2027**Työaika:** Pääasiassa ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian / sopimuksen mukaanHae heti!**Tarvitsemme uusia työntekijöitä pikaisella aikataululla!**Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, mahdollisesta aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa.Et tarvitse pitkää työhistoriaa – hyvä asenne ja halu tehdä töitä ratkaisevat!**Hakemukset:** toimisto@peuramaa.fi**Lisätiedot:** 050-5555880**Tervetuloa Peuramaan talvitiimiin!**

title: Restaurant Cleaner – Temporary Assignment in Tornio and Turku
description: MAW Siivouspalvelut Oy is recruiting one cleaner for temporary restaurant cleaning work, first in Tornio and then in Turku.The assignment includes work in Tornio until 30 November 2026, followed by temporary cover in Turku until 5 January 2027. Applicants should state their earliest available start date and whether they can undertake both consecutive assignments, including moving between the cities.Duties include cleaning restaurant kitchens, dining areas, toilets, floors and other agreed areas, with an additional two hours of office cleaning per week in Tornio.Working hours are 30.5 hours per week in Tornio and 30 hours per week in Turku. Shifts are mainly in the early morning, across six days per week, with weekly rest arranged in the work schedule.The basic hourly wage is €12.59, plus applicable supplements under the property services sector collective agreement.We are looking for a reliable person who works carefully, follows cleaning and safety instructions, and can work independently after induction. Previous restaurant cleaning experience is an advantage. Instructions and supervision are provided in English.The employee arranges accommodation and relocation between Tornio and Turku. Any travel payments required by the applicable collective agreement will be handled accordingly.The employment is temporary, covering the remaining Tornio assignment and an employees absence in Turku. Further work after 5 January 2027 is not guaranteed.Please apply by email to asiakaspalvelu@maw.fi. Include a short description of your relevant experience, your earliest starting date, and your availability for the assignments in both cities.

title: Myyntiedustaja (kodinturvaratkaisut)
description: **Haluatko myyntityön, jossa päiväsi eivät kulu kylmäsoittoihin tai asiakkaiden perässä juoksemiseen? Etsimme nyt myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijoita rooliin, jossa tärkein tehtäväsi on auttaa asiakkaita suojaamaan kotinsa ja yrityksensä Verisuren palveluilla.****Jos nautit tavoitteellisesta myynnistä, kaupan syntymisen tunteesta sekä asiakaskohtaamisista,rooli on juuri sinua varten.**Myynti ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijanamme et lähde liikkeelle tyhjästä. Jokaiselle päivällesi rakennetaan valmiiksi laadukkaita myyntimahdollisuuksia sovittujen asiakastapaamisten, nykyasiakaskäyntien sekä huoltojen ja asennusten kautta. Tavoitteena on yksinkertaisesti luoda mahdollisimman paljon onnistuneita kohtaamisia ja kauppoja.Tarjoamme sinulle 1500 € kuukausittaisen pohjapalkan, kannustavan palkkiomallin sekä Suomen tunnetuimman ja luotetuimman turvapalvelun myytäväksesi. Kun vahva brändi, toimiva konsepti ja jatkuva asiakasvirta yhdistyy, sinulle syntyy erinomaiset mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa omalla tekemiselläsi ansiotasoosi.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Varma pohjapalkka & motivoivat komissiot:** Tarjoamme sinulle **jatkuvan pohjapalkan 1500€/kk** sekä kannustavat ja motivoivat komissiot: uusista hankituista asiakkaista saat keskimäärin n. **300-400€ myyntikomission.** - **Lämpimät asiakaskohtaamiset:** Varmistamme sinulle riittävästi monipuolisia myynniin mahdollisuuksia niin valmiiksi sovittujen asiakastapaamisten kuin nykyasiakkailla tapahtuvien käyntien muodossa. - **Perehdytyksen, jota on hiottu yli 30 vuoden ajan:** Olemme kehittäneet koulutustamme sekä perehdytystämme pitkään, joten saat käyttöösi vinkit, neuvot ja tuen, joiden avulla onnistumisesi on vain sinusta itsestäsi kiinni. - **Autoetu:** Saat käyttöösi auton, jolla ajat niin työ- kuin vapaa-ajallasi. - **Eteneminen**: Kaikki myynnin esihenkilömme ovat aloittaneet myyjinä. Saat konkreettisen mahdollisuuden rakentaa uraasi eteenpäin. Sales Manager Naneten tarinaan pääse tutustumaan urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura). - **Best Place to Work sertifioidun organisaation.** Sijoituimme Suomen keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa parhaimpien joukkoon. Katso urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura) myyjiemme kokemuksia Verisurella työskentelemisestä. **Mitä päiväsi myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijana tarkemmin pitää sisällään?**Tyypillinen työpäiväsi alkaa esimerkiksi klo 10:00 tapaamisella, jossa asiakas odottaa sinua luoksensa. Onnistut tapaamisella vakuuttamaan hänet palvelusta, ja pääset sopimaan järjestelmän asennuksen heti huomiselle. Jatkat tästä päivääsi toisen asiakkaasi luokse, jossa suoritat hänen järjestelmänsä huollon. Järjestelmän huollon yhteydessä tarjoat parasta mahdollista palvelua ja selvität, onko asiakkaalla muita suojaamista kaipaavia kohteita, tai mahdollisesti tuttuja, joille hän haluaisi palvelua suositella.Päiväsi jatkuu mökkikohteella, jonne toteutat asennuksen, jonka olit sopinut viime viikolla turvattuasi ensin asiakkaan kotikohteen. Asennusten ja huoltojen yhteydessä kontaktoit myös lähialueen talot kartoittaaksesi uusia mahdollisia asiakkaita.Viikkosi koostuu monipuolisesti erilaisista kohtaamisista niin uusien kuin nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa, sisältäen tapaamisia, asennuksia, huoltoja ja lähialueen suoraa asiakaskontaktointia. Tärkein tehtäväsi on siis toteuttaa mahdollisimman monen uuden kodin ja yritystilan suojaaminen Verisuren palvelulla.**Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti ma–pe klo 10:00–18:00.** Työ on aktiivista kenttätyötä, joten tiimipalavereja ja koulutuksia lukuun ottamatta toimit pääsääntöisesti kentällä asiakkaidesi luona.**Voisiko tämä olla sinun seuraava uramahdollisuus?**Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa motivaatiota tavoitteellista myyntityötä kohtaan sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiemmat näytöt suoramyynnin parista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömyys. Työssä tehtävät asennukset ja huollot eivät vaadi aiempaa kokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinut niihin.**Tehtävässä edellytämme sinulta:**- Ajokorttia: Tarvitset B-kortin (manuaali) ja täysikäisyyttä. - Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä. - Pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti arkisin 10:00-18:00 välillä. - Tausta: Edellytämme on nuhteetonta rikostaustaa (edellytys turvasuojaajakortille). **Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Jos uusi myyntiroolimme sytytti kiinnostukseksi, klikkaa linkkiä, jätä CV sekä yhteystietosi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä. title: Health and Safety Manager/Health and Safety Assistant Manager / Admin (Data Centre )
description: HSE Manager & HSE Assistant Manager – Data Centre Construction Project**Location:** Vihti, Finland**Company:** Mono Rakennus Oy**Project:** Data Centre**Employment Type:** Full-time, Fixed-term (12–15 months)**Open Positions:** 2We are currently looking for two qualified HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) professionals for a major international data centre construction project in Vihti, Finland.**Position 1:** HSE Manager (1 Position)**Key Responsibilities:**- Lead and manage daily HSE operations on the construction site. - Ensure compliance with Finnish occupational health and safety legislation and project-specific safety requirements. - Develop, implement and monitor HSE procedures, policies and safety management systems. - Prepare, review and approve Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) within the scope of assigned authority. - Conduct site inspections, safety audits and risk assessments. - Investigate incidents, accidents and near misses, and implement corrective actions. - Coordinate safety inductions, toolbox talks and HSE training. - Monitor subcontractor compliance with safety regulations. - Attend HSE meetings and coordinate with the general contractor and other project stakeholders. - Prepare regular HSE performance reports and maintain safety records. - Prepare lifting plans and other required plans for different activities. **Requirements:**- Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification in occupational health and safety, or engineering background. - Minimum 1 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably in construction. - Experience in large-scale industrial or data centre construction projects. - Strong knowledge of Finnish occupational health and safety legislation. - Experience with RAMS, inspections, audits and incident investigations. - Excellent communication and organisational skills. - Good command of English. - Valid Finnish Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti). - NEBOSH, IOSH certification or equivalent HSE qualification is considered an advantage. **Position 2:** HSE Assistant Manager / Administrator (1 Position)**Key Responsibilities:**- Support the HSE Manager in daily site safety operations. - Assist with site inspections, audits and safety monitoring. - Prepare and maintain HSE documentation, reports and records. - Support the preparation and administration of RAMS. - Coordinate safety inductions, toolbox talks and training records. - Maintain incident reports, safety observations and corrective action registers. - Assist in monitoring subcontractor compliance with site safety requirements. - Organise HSE meetings, prepare minutes and follow up on action items. - Maintain and update electronic HSE management systems. - Support communication between the HSE team, site management and subcontractors. **Requirements:**- Relevant education or professional experience in occupational health and safety, construction or administration. - Previous experience in an HSE support, coordination or construction administration role. - Good understanding of construction site safety procedures. - Strong organisational, reporting and documentation skills. - Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. - Good command of English. - Valid Finnish Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti). - NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent safety training is considered an advantage. - Experience in data centre construction is an advantage. What We Offer- Full-time employment on a major international data centre project. - Expected employment duration of 12–15 months. - Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience. - Professional and international working environment. - Opportunity to contribute to a significant construction project in Finland. How to ApplyInterested candidates should send their CV, relevant certificates, salary expectations and earliest availability to:**noman.nasery@monorakennus.fi**Please indicate clearly which position you are applying for:- **HSE Manager - Vihti** - **HSE Assistant Manager - Vihti** Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

title: Electrical Designers for Data Center, Industrial and Building Services Projects, AINS group, Espoo
description: Welcome to AINS Group, a forward-thinking engineering and consulting company specialising in the built environment. At AINS Group, we foster a culture where our experts and clients can succeed together. We offer the opportunities and benefits of a large company combined with the straightforward, approachable culture of a smaller organisation and an inspiring, award-winning work community.Come build a better future with us!We are looking for Electrical Designers to strengthen our community of industrial and building services experts in Espoo, Finland.At AINS Group, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse and technically interesting projects, designing functional, safe and energy-efficient electrical solutions that meet our clients needs. Depending on your experience and expertise, your projects may focus on data centers, industrial facilities, building electrical systems or hospital environments.As an Electrical Designer, you will work on a variety of electrical design and specialist assignments as part of multidisciplinary project teams. You will design functional, safe and practical electrical systems that take into account the specific requirements of each project and operating environment. In data center and other critical infrastructure projects, particular emphasis is placed on the reliability and uninterrupted operation of electrical systems.The variety of our projects and AINS Groups extensive network of experts give you the opportunity to work in different operating environments and on diverse design assignments.We would be happy to hear what kind of expertise and experience you would bring to our team. The exact content and focus of the role can be tailored according to your skills, experience and professional interests.What we expect from you- a suitable technical degree, such as a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering- previous experience in electrical design- experience with MagiCAD and/or Revit- good collaboration and communication skills- a good command of English for professional purposes.The role can be performed in English, and Finnish language skills are not required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. Previous experience in data center projects is also considered an advantage.What will help you succeed in this roleA curious mindset, attention to detail and a willingness to continuously develop both your own expertise and project practices will support your success in the role. We expect an independent and responsible approach to work as well as the confidence to contribute your professional expertise and views.At AINS Group, we trust our experts, and no one is expected to know or solve everything alone. We ask questions, exchange ideas and share our expertise.We invest in you and your work communityWe want our people to have the opportunity to develop their expertise and build career paths that reflect their individual strengths and ambitions. You will be supported by a skilled and encouraging work community as well as an extensive network of experts with whom you can solve demanding design challenges.AINS Group is recognised as one of Finlands most attractive employers among engineering professionals (Universum 2026). Our sense of community is also visible in everyday working life: our offices gather for a shared breakfast every weekday morning, and colleagues connect not only at their desks but also over shared lunches and afternoon coffee.In addition to flexible ways of working, we offer comprehensive occupational healthcare, a bonus scheme, a lunch benefit and a flexible wellbeing benefit that can be used for sports, culture, commuting or massage. Our benefits also include a company bicycle scheme and shared sports and wellbeing activities.At AINS Group, you can build your own career path by deepening your specialist expertise, as career development does not have to mean moving into a management role. You will have the opportunities of a large company around you, combined with a work community where people work together, trust one anothers expertise and are encouraged to share their views.Employment details- Start date: As agreed.- Employment and working hours: Permanent, full-time employment, 37.5 hours per week. Flexible working hours between 6:00–9:00 and 15:00–18:00.- Working model: Flexible hybrid work, with opportunities and encouragement to work together at the office.- Location: Espoo, Finland.- Employer: AINS Group.Interested?The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation between AINS Group and StaffPoint. Please submit your CV and application through StaffPoints recruitment system as soon as possible. The application period ends on 18 January 2027, but we review applications and move forward with suitable candidates already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply early.In your application, tell us about the types of projects and assignments you are particularly interested in and highlight the electrical design experience most relevant to this role. For information security reasons, we do not accept applications by email.For more information about the role and the recruitment process, please contact:Sanna ApiainenRecruitment Consultant, StaffPoint+358 45 7881 5660sanna.apiainen@staffpoint.fiAbout AINS GroupAINS Group – your team for better and bolder construction.Learn more about AINS Group, our areas of expertise and our work at [www.ains.fi/en](http://www.ains.fi/en).AINS groupAt AINS Group, we create a culture where our experts and customers succeed together. At the same time, we challenge the entire industry to renew sustainably.We offer the benefits of a large company and the agility of a small house. Our Kasvupolut (Growth Paths) program provides an opportunity to develop your expertise and grow into roles that match your aspirations.Get to know us and our business areas in construction management, architectural design, structural engineering, renovation design, industrial and building services engineering, as well as civil and environmental engineering at [www.ains.fi/en](http://www.ains.fi).Founded 1959Colleagues 1400+Turnover €147 millionEmail: sanna.apiainen@staffpoint.fi

title: Driver (D1/D), Pyhätunturi, Lapland, Finland
description: **Join our team as a Driver in Pyhätunturi!**Were looking for a Driver for the upcoming winter season, whose main responsibility will be safari and shuttle transport for our guests. Your background can be in professional driving, or in activity guiding where transporting guests has been part of your role. The exact duties will be tailored to the skills of the selected person.As our Driver, you are often the first and last person our guests meet, so a safe driving style matters just as much as warm, professional service.Sunday Morning Collection offers premium accommodation, dining and outdoor experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park. We operate according to the principles of sustainable tourism, with safety and authentic experiences at the heart of everything we do.**Your main responsibilities / transport:**- Safari transport: driving guests to and from activity sites - Shuttle transport within the Pyhätunturi area - Airport transfers and private transfers as needed - Welcoming and assisting guests, including help with luggage - Daily vehicle checks, cleanliness, refuelling and charging - Driving safely and punctually in changing winter conditions **Depending on your skills, also maintenance duties:**- General maintenance and support duties around the resort area - Heating and maintaining our lakeside saunas - Preparing and servicing activity equipment, including electric snowmobiles, skis and snowshoes **Requirements:**- A valid Category D1 or D driving licence and a Driver Certificate of Professional Competence - Experience transporting passengers, either as a professional driver or in activity/outdoor tourism; winter driving experience is a strong advantage - A safe, calm and responsible driving style - An excellent customer service attitude and strong communication skills - Fluent English; Finnish is a significant advantage and additional languages are appreciated **Considered an advantage:**- Experience in property maintenance or technical support work - Experience in activity guiding, outdoor tourism or wilderness guiding - A First Aid (EA1) certificate (training provided if needed) - Good physical fitness and the ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions **What we offer:**- A varied role where no two days are ever the same - The chance to try our experiences free of charge, so you know first-hand what our guests enjoy - Staff benefits on our own products and services - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - A friendly, professional and close-knit team - Comprehensive onboarding before the season begins and training for our activities - Affordable staff accommodation, if required - Comprehensive occupational healthcare - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent workplace location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - Salary according to the Finnish Programme Services Collective Agreement (Job Requirement Group B, approx. 2,095 - 2,337€/month). The final salary is based on your experience and the focus of your duties. **Employment details**The position begins in early December 2026, or as agreed, and continues until the end of the 2027 spring season (late March / early April). This is a full-time seasonal position.**About us**Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned company offering premium accommodation, dining and activity experiences in Pyhä-Luosto National Park. During the winter season we organise electric snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights experiences, snowshoe adventures, ice fishing excursions, farm visits and more. Sunday Morning Collection also includes Sunday Morning Resort, Parkside Pyhä Apartments and Restaurant Aihki.**Interested?**Send your application with the subject Driver / Your Name to rekry@sundaymorning.fi, together with your CV and salary expectation. Tell us about your licence categories, your passenger transport experience and why youd like to spend the winter with our team.The application period ends on 29 November 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish time). We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.Applications & enquiries: rekry@sundaymorning.fi | www.sundaymorning.fi

title: IT Manager - Service management
description: Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.Our Sandvik Mining and Rock Solutions (SMR) IT Delivery organization supports end to end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation, and service operations.We are now looking for IT Manager - Customer Portal. The position is permanent and preferred location is Tampere, Finland, where several key business stakeholders and Sandvik divisions are located.Your Mission as IT Manager (Service Owner)As an IT Manager, you will lead a team of Sandvik employees and contractors at the same time while acting as the Service Owner for a portfolio of business-critical services, including the My Sandvik Customer Portal, eBusiness solutions covering integrated customer ordering channels and B2B ERP transactions, customer-specific integration solutions, and technical documentation management services such as the Documoto document storage platform, ensuring they deliver business value, excellent user experiences, and reliable global operations.You ensure these services deliver business value, excellent user experiences, and reliable global operations while driving their continuous development and performance. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, development teams, suppliers, and service providers, you lead service delivery, governance, capacity planning, financial control, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.In your Service Owner capacity, you are accountable for ensuring these services deliver business value, excellent user experiences, reliable global operations, and continuous improvement. You will oversee service performance, governance, capacity planning, financial control, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.At the same time, you will provide day-to-day leadership and direction for a team consisting of Sandvik employees and contractors, fostering collaboration, engagement, and strong execution. While supplier-managed service teams are led operationally by their respective suppliers, you will own the service relationship and ensure that suppliers deliver according to agreed service levels, contractual commitments, business expectations, and strategic objectives.Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, development teams, suppliers, and service providers, you will drive service excellence, governance, and continuous improvement across the entire service portfolio.What can you bring to our team?We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with strong expertise in IT service management, stakeholder leadership, vendor management, and budget responsibility. You have a proven track record of managing business-critical IT services in a global environment and can balance business needs, service delivery, governance, supplier relationships, and continuous service development.You build trusted relationships across international stakeholder networks and work proactively to drive results. While not necessarily a hands-on technical specialist, you are comfortable discussing integrations, application landscapes, security requirements, and service roadmaps with both business and technical audiences.We value leaders who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve services, ways of working, and team performance. The ability to lead through influence, foster collaboration, and create business value in a complex global environment is essential for success in this role.Key qualifications· 5+ years of experience in Functional Manager, IT Service Owner/Manager, Application Manager, Product Owner, or similar roles· Proven experience in Service Management, including ITSM and ITIL processes, workflow development, service tools, and SLA/OLA management.· Strong financial management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, cost monitoring, cost optimization, and communicating financial impacts to stakeholders. Accounting knowledge is considered an advantage.· Ability to work effectively with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and development teams in agile development environments.· Ability to bridge business and technology by translating architectural vision into practical solutions.· Experience with ERP, CRM, B2B eCommerce, EDI, sales and invoicing processes, preferably in large, integration-heavy enterprise environments.· Familiarity with Ariba, Peppol, Coupa, or similar integration platforms.· Ability to drive initiatives independently in a globally distributed organization.· Experience of leading through influence rather than direct authority is highly appreciated.· Experience in IT supplier management and IT service agreements· You hold self-driven, goal-oriented, agile mindset.· You have an ability to operate independently and effectively in a dynamic environment.· Bachelors or masters degree in IT, Business, Engineering, or a related field· Fluent English language skills· Finnish or Swedish language skills are beneficial but not required.Required Tools & Technologies· Jira & Confluence· ServiceNow· Power BI· Microsoft Office Suite· SAP Ariba (customer order management)· Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, Peppol, .NET will be advantages.· Azure knowledge is a plusSandvik will offer you - A glimpse of our cultureSandvik will offer an opportunity for you to influence and structure our organization with new and innovative ways of working, good perks, flexible hybrid work, and an opportunity to continuously learn with a good work-life balance. Company has a truly international environment with great opportunities for your professional development and growth.We have an inclusive company...

title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
description: **Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.**Your responsibilities include:**- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards - Working across different kitchen stations during daily service - Preparing and handling ingredients - Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards - Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients - Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures - Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service - Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams **We are looking for someone who has:**- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience - A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience - Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage - Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients - An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work - The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment - Good teamwork and communication skills - Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage - Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally - Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food **We offer you:**- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants - The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine - An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland - The support of a welcoming, professional and international team - Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins - The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace - Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - Employee benefits for selected activities - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary **Employment**The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.**About us****Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to developing tourism responsibly, respecting the unique nature of Lapland and working closely with local businesses and partners.As an employer, we believe in a positive working atmosphere, open communication, strong team spirit and opportunities for professional growth. With us, you'll work with international guests in the beautiful surroundings of Pyhätunturi as part of a skilled and close-knit team.Restaurant Aihki is the restaurant of Sunday Morning Resort, combining the flavours and local ingredients of Lapland with contemporary Scandinavian influences. Throughout the season, we also organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings.Discover Restaurant Aihki on Instagram **@restaurantaihki** and at **sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**.**Interested?**Please send your application with the subject line **Chef Aihki / \[Your Name\]**, together with your CV and salary expectation.Tell us about your background, professional experience and why you would like to spend the upcoming winter season as part of the Aihki team.We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply early.**Applications and enquiries:**- rekry@sundaymorning.fi - sundaymorning.fi

title: On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal
description: We are looking for an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, with the main responsibility of assisting our teams with various tax and legal matters. The position is estimated to involve approximately two working days per week. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.As an On-Call Trainee, you can work up to 25 hours per week. The person selected for this role needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.Your role and responsibilitiesAs an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, your work will include tasks related to income tax, transfer pricing, international tax matters, indirect tax, as well as other tasks within the Group Tax team and tasks within the Corporate & M&A Legal team. Youll be working as part of the Group Tax team and the Corporate & M&A Legal team in a truly international environment. You will probably start many of your tasks by checking Google Maps to see where the relevant company is located, as Wärtsilä has companies or branches in over 100 countries.To succeed in the position, we expect you to have: * Late-stage Bachelors or mid- to late-stage Masters level studies in Economics and Business Administration, Law, or a similar field * Interest in taxation and motivation to learn about income tax, transfer pricing, indirect tax, and international taxation * Interest in gaining insight into and participating in corporate legal work * Excellent communication and writing skills in English; Finnish or Swedish language skills are considered an advantage * Some relevant previous work experience; experience in taxation and/or law is a plus but not mandatory * An organised, focused, and proactive working style with a flexible and positive attitude * Experience using various IT systems and tools, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is an advantageWhats in it for you? * The opportunity to learn about taxation and law, and the roles and responsibilities of the Tax and Legal functions of an international listed company * Induction and training, professional development within the fields of tax and law, and valuable hands-on experience * The opportunity to become a valued and integral member of the Group Tax team, with support for your studies and future career, as well as the opportunity to participate in and become integrated into the tasks of the Corporate & M&A Legal team * Flexible working hours and the possibility to work partly remotelyWhy you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact & next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon and receive your application via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated throughout the process.For further information regarding this position, please reach out to Jouni Arpalahti, Director, Corporate Taxes, at jouni.arpalahti@wartsila.com regarding this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications by email will not be recorded or responded to).Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

title: On-Call Trainee, Process Engineering
description: We are looking for anOn-Call Trainee, Process Engineering, with the main responsibility of supporting fuel systems process design activities. The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.As an On-call Trainee, you can work up to 25 hours per week. The selected candidate needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.Your role and responsibilitiesIn this On-Call Trainee, Process Engineering role, your work will include designing P&IDs for fuel supply systems for LNG, methanol, and ammonia, performing thermodynamics and fluid dynamics simulations, defining technical specifications for process equipment (pumps, heat exchangers), and developing operating and functional procedures. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests. title: Digital Growth Marketing Manager
description: _Fastems is a global partner for machining manufacturers, delivering intelligent automation for cutting machine tools and surrounding processes. We are a family-owned business with 40 years of automation experience, over 5000 installations and main markets in Europe, North America and Asia. Our mission is to help metalworking manufacturers improve their productivity and profitability. Globally, there are already 450 of us learning, growing and prospering together. At Fastems you get to work with some of the brightest people in the industry, so every day is an opportunity to learn something new._We are looking for a **Digital Growth Marketing Manager** to join our global marketing team and drive growth through digital channels. You will own our growth marketing engine and keep optimizing and improving it based on data and AI. We are looking for someone who really loves digital marketing, has a proactive working style, and thinks systematically and creatively. You bring a positive attitude, a collaborative mindset and a good sense of humour. A little spark in your eyes doesnt hurt either.**What will you get to work on?****Marketing automation & CRM**You will own and continuously develop our lead pipeline in Salesforce Sales Cloud, helping marketing and sales work smoothly together. You will also support localized prospecting activities and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing and customer engagement journeys across Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud.**Website, SEO & GEO**You will take ownership of our new website (which will be published soon) built on WordPress, and develop it further with our web partner. Your focus is SEO and GEO visibility, digital customer journeys, conversion and analytics – ensuring a site that drives engagement.**Growth marketing**You will drive demand generation through LinkedIn, Meta, SEO/GEO, SEM, and other digital channels. You create, run, measure and optimize campaigns based on collected data. The target is qualified demand and a real contribution to sales, not just traffic.**Marketing AI**You will lead the development of our marketing AI strategy and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. You will identify where AI creates business value, help define the required data, technologies and integrations, and work with partners to make it happen. Quality, security and human oversight remain important throughout.**Analytics & performance**You will build visibility across the marketing and sales funnel. Your insights will help us understand what creates qualified demand, what converts, what needs improvement and where we should invest next.**Who will you work with?**You will have a lot of ownership, but you are not on your own. You work closely with colleagues in marketing, sales, product management, and with external partners. You are in charge of digital strategy and implementation, working closely with your teammates who lead content creation.**What will you bring with you?**- A hands-on digital marketing enthusiast who thinks systemically, enjoys working with data and technology and wants to understand what really drives business results - Strategic and analytical person who can both plan and execute - Curiosity about AI, marketing technology and new ways of working - with business value first in mind - Good project management and teamwork skills - Proactive and independent way of working - 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, MarTech or a similar role - Fluent in English and at least basic Finnish skills for everyday workplace - Experience in international B2B marketing of technically complex products, manufacturing or industrial automation is a plus **Location and ways of working**Our office is located in **Lahdesjärvi, Tampere**. We offer flexible hybrid working and the possibility to work partly remotely. However, this role also requires regular on-site presence in Tampere to support close collaboration with the team and key stakeholders.**We can offer you:**- A key role in shaping digital growth at a global industrial automation company. - Fastems strong company culture expressed through our values. - Career and development opportunities. - International work atmosphere and global activities. - Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely. - Comprehensive employee benefits, such as culture and lunch benefit at the office. **Interested in joining #fastemsians?**For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact:Teemu-Pekka Ahonen / Head of Product Management & Marketing: teemu.ahonen@fastems.comSend your application together with your CV and salary request **by November 29th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

title: FA Solutions: Solution Consultant (Fintech SaaS, Riga or Helsinki)
description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki / Riga**Application deadline:** 29.11.2026Are you passionate about finance, technology and helping clients succeed? Join FA Solutions growing team as a **Solution Consultant** and turn complex business needs into practical solutions!FA Solutions is a market leading provider of software for Asset & Wealth Managers, helping them manage their investments globally. The company offers a cloud-based Portfolio Management solution that automates and centralizes a wide range of operational processes into one easy-to-use FA Platform.FA Solutions is committed to delivering a robust and scalable solution that prioritises user experience, data security, and compliance, allowing the client companies to leverage the power of open architecture and interoperability.**What will you be doing?**As a Solution Consultant, you will play a central role in helping FAs new clients to start running their business on FA platform and to help FAs existing clients to get the most out of the FA system capabilities.The role combines project management, investment management knowledge and technical problem-solving, with a strong emphasis on client relationships and delivering business value.**Your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle:**- Taking ownership of designing new client-specific solutions by mapping business requirements with the platforms capabilities and best practices - Configuring and customizing the platform to meet client needs, including light scripting and data migration - Coordinating implementation projects, communicating progress, and ensuring delivery quality - Conducting workshops and training sessions for client users - Contributing to improvement projects for existing clients, from gap analysis to delivery You'll collaborate closely with account management, product management, customer support and delivery partners, while maintaining an active dialogue with clients throughout the projects.You will manage several long-term projects simultaneously and work closely with clients, particularly in the UK and Iceland.**What makes you a great fit?**You will work with various stakeholders and clients, which highlights the importance of excellent communication and collaboration skills. As your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle, you'll also need basic project management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to deliver training sessions and host workshops.You might be the talent we are looking for if you enjoy bringing people, processes and technology together. You can confidently lead client discussions, structure complex requirements and keep projects moving forward. You are curious about how financial businesses operate and motivated to learn new software solutions. You do not need to be a programmer to succeed in this role.**We require you to have:**- Minimum 2 years of experience in consulting, software implementation, professional services or client-facing project delivery - Good understanding of financial services or investment management, or a strong interest in developing your expertise in the field - A genuine interest in working with clients and the ability to succeed in a customer-facing environment - Experience coordinating projects, managing stakeholders and translating business requirements into practical solutions - A full professional proficiency and presentation skills in English **We consider as an asset:**- Experience in investment management industry - Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project methodologies - Experience with Jira or similar project management tools - Some experience in scripting (Java, JavaScript, SQL or similar) **FA Solutions offers you:**- The opportunity to own meaningful client projects and see how your work improves financial institutions' everyday operations - A collaborative international team where you can learn from experienced colleagues and work with clients across different markets - Room to grow into a senior consulting, team leadership or specialist role as your expertise develops - The flexibility and speed of a startup, backed by the resources and stability of an established company - Flexible working hours and remote work policy - Auntie well-being service, occupational health care in Finland, health insurance in Latvia - Bonus model **Practicalities:**This is a full-time and permanent position, in which you will be employed directly to FA Solutions.You will join the Professional Services team either in **Helsinki, Finland,** or **Riga, Latvia**, depending on your current location and preference. The role also includes a flexible hybrid arrangement. The role involves occasional international travel, particularly to the UK and Iceland, depending on client projects.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4500 €/month based on your experience.**Does this sound like the next step in your career?**Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English latest by the 29th of November via aTalent's application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397753/create/.Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.You can familiarize yourself with FA Solutions here: https://fasolutions.com. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlström (+358 44 902 0238, kiira.dahlstrom\[at\]atalent.fi).

title: Full Stack Developer (C#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL), Wärtsilä
description: About the roleAs a Full Stack Developer, you will join a dynamic 11-person team dedicated to upgrading and maintaining Wärtsilä's global sales tools. Your primary focus will be a migration project, translating legacy product configurator code into modern languages to support global marine sales.In this role, you will focus on developing, maintaining, and modernizing Wärtsiläs internal global sales tools, quotation systems, and rule-based product configurators. As Wärtsiläs business is growing rapidly, the team is currently executing a key upgrade project to ensure sales teams have modern, high-performing tools at their disposal. Your primary focus will be translating and migrating existing Visual Basic-based configurator logic into modern web technologies using C# (.NET), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.You will join a team of 11 professionals. Because the tools are directly tied to Wärtsiläs engine portfolio, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Product Management, and R&amp;D to verify requirements and ensure seamless functionality.Work tasks- Translate existing product configurator code from Visual Basic to JavaScript, HTML, and C#- Develop new features and maintain global sales tools, quotation systems, and SQL databases- Collaborate actively with Sales, Product Management, and R&D stakeholders to clarify business rules and technical requirements- Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, and hyper-care support following project milestones- Provide hyper-support and maintenance for the newly upgraded tools post-launchWe are looking for- A few years of relevant work experience in FullStack development, specifically C# (.NET), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS- Good practical knowledge of relational databases and SQL- Fluent English skills- Strong self-direction and proactive communication skills, with the confidence to network internally and ask questions when troubleshooting complex logicIt is meritorious if you have- Previous experience working at WärtsiläOther information:Start: In December or in JanuaryLocation: Preferably Vaasa, Helsinki (occasional visits to Vaasa)Employment period: At least untill the end of 2027, extension possible&nbsp;Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Senior Sales Manager – Industrial Digitalization Solutions
description: Are you passionate about industrial digitalization sales and a persistent customer value builder – do you have an innovative and proactive approach in driving business growth, bringing new perspectives and finding new solutions for industrial companies?Etteplan is growing and we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join us. The purpose is to drive growth within selected strategic industrial manufacturing and production customers globally, including defense, energy, mining and autonomous vehicles as particular focus sectors. You get energy from working with customers, and act as an example to inspire your colleagues to meet customer expectations. - A minimum of five years of proven success in international business solution sales within the engineering or technology services industry, specifically in selling to industrial customers in manufacturing, production, and R&amp;D environments. - Proven B2B sales track record in industrial platform and software solutions.
