title: Senior Reliability Engineer
description: Join us as a Senior Reliability Engineer and play a key role in ensuring the long-term performance and reliability of critical manufacturing assets.The position is part of the local Maintenance & Reliability organisation in Uppsala and works cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance and other key stakeholders.As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will act as a key technical specialist on both operational and strategic levels, driving the development of a proactive, data-driven reliability and maintenance culture. You will also collaborate closely with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with corporate standards, best practices and long-term strategic objectives.We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and is motivated by turning analysis into action.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your missionAs a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability and long-term performance of manufacturing systems and equipment across our operations.Using data, engineering expertise and structured problem solving, you will identify improvement opportunities, assess equipment and asset lifecycles, and support decisions on maintenance strategies, upgrades and future investments.In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise in reliability engineering and asset performance management, supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Through collaboration with local and global stakeholders, you will help shape maintenance practices, improve asset reliability and contribute to sustainable business performance.This is a senior role that requires a high degree of ownership and initiative. You are comfortable working independently, building strong relationships across functions and driving improvements from idea through to implementation.You will join a team of experienced engineers who play an important role in supporting operational excellence and the continued development of our Uppsala site. Key Responsibilities· Drive reliability engineering initiatives across manufacturing operations, systems and equipment.· Lead and facilitate reliability assessments using methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA and FMECA.· Analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement measurable reliability improvements.· Develop and optimise preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset availability and reduce operational risk.· Support asset lifecycle management and contribute to investment decisions through data-driven recommendations.· Monitor and improve maintenance performance indicators (KPIs) and reliability metrics.· Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Production, Automation, QA and Facilities to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.· Collaborate with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with company standards and strategic objectives.· Promote a proactive, reliability-focused culture through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.· Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve operational performance Your profile You are an experienced engineer with a background in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management within an industrial environment.You are comfortable working with complex technical challenges and understand how to translate data into practical actions and long-term improvements. Equally important, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders and thrive in an environment where initiative and collaboration are valued. What you'll bring· A university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.· Minimum 5 years of experience within reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management in an industrial environment.· Strong knowledge and practical experience of reliability methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA/FMECA and preventive maintenance optimisation.· Proven ability to analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement sustainable reliability improvements.· Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and maintenance performance indicators (KPIs).· Strong knowledge of asset lifecycle management and maintenance strategies.· Experience from a regulated manufacturing environment.· Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.· Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage. Location and otherThis position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to submit their application as soon as possible. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

title: 3D Model responsible
description: A Snapshot of Your DayJoin us as a Layout Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in coordinating the overall design of our projects. You will leverage your strong CAD skills, preferably in NX, to create and manage 3D models that accurately reflect the combined input from various engineering disciplines. Your attention to detail and structured approach will ensure that all layout drawings meet project requirements and support customer planning for foundations, buildings, and utilities. title: HIL Testning

title: PhD position in Agricultural Science
description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyThird-cycle subject area: Agricultural SciencePhD Project: Sustainability Assessment of Agroecological Farming SystemsDescription of the doctoral projectThe PhD project is a collaboration between the Animal Centred Environments group and the Horticultural and Agroecological Systems (HAS) subject area within the Department. The doctoral research will focus on sustainability assessment of agroecological livestock farming systems, drawing on expertise across both groups and involving collaboration with researchers, farmers and other stakeholders across Europe and Africa through ALASTRA and STRONG MCSA.About the positionHow can sustainability assessment support the transition to more resilient and sustainable farming systems? This PhD project will investigate how multi-criteria approaches can capture the environmental, economic and social performance of agroecological farming systems, identify synergies and trade-offs, and support decisions by farmers and other agricultural stakeholders.The doctoral student will work primarily within ALASTRA (Agroecology Living Labs in Africa: Redefining the Role of Animals in Food Systems for Climate Action and Sustainability), an EU-funded Horizon Europe project. ALASTRA brings together researchers, farmers and other stakeholders to co-design and evaluate agroecological livestock farming practices through living labs in Kenya, Tanzania, Tunisia and Zambia. SLU leads the development of the holistic assessment framework, including the selection of indicators and the design of sampling and data collection protocols.The doctoral student will contribute to developing, adapting and evaluating this framework. The research will draw on approaches such as the Global Farm Metric and established agroecological assessment tools, including OASISm the PG tool and TAPE.The doctoral student will also contribute to STRONG MCSA, an EU-funded Erasmus+ project that strengthens agricultural stakeholders’ capacity to use multi-criteria sustainability assessment (MCSA). These activities will provide a complementary foundation for the doctoral research in ALASTRA.The doctoral project will combine literature-based research, development and evaluation of assessment methods, quantitative and qualitative data analysis, and engagement with farmers, advisors and researchers. The student will collaborate with partners in Europe and Africa, contribute to project workshops and scientific publications, and communicate findings to academic and practitioner audiences. International visits and participation in project activities may form part of the doctoral studies.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).The following specific entry requirements apply: For the subject of agricultural science, the applicant must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.Your profileRequired qualifications    A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Agroecology, Agricultural Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Science, or a related field    A good understanding of agricultural systems, agroecology and sustainability challenges    Experience in research methods and quantitative data analysis, demonstrated through a degree project or equivalent work    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken    Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an international, multidisciplinary teamDesirable qualifications    Knowledge or experience of Multi Criteria Sustainability Assessment (MCSA), Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), indicator development or farm assessment tools    Experience with literature reviews and the comparative analysis of methods or tools    Experience with statistical analysis and software such as R, or with qualitative research methods    Knowledge of livestock farming, grazing systems, soil health or agroecological transitions    Experience collaborating with farmers, advisors or other agricultural stakeholders, including participatory research or workshops    Experience working in African agricultural contexts or other international research settings    Interest or experience in developing training resources and communicating research to practitioners    Good communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language    A valid car driver’s licence recognized in SwedenAbout usAt the Department of Biosystems and Technology, we explore interactions between soil, plants, animals, the environment, climate, and humans in systems for sustainable food production and renewable raw materials.More information about the department on As a Merchant of Record, we handle onboarding, compliance, reporting and payouts so companies can scale creator programmes across markets.As our Finance & Compliance Operations Specialist, you will run the daily operational work that keeps payments moving accurately and customers supported. You will match incoming client payments, provide final sign-off on creator payouts, manage balances across accounts and currencies, and resolve exceptions such as failed, reversed or duplicate payouts.You will also handle support cases within our four-hour response target, support agency onboarding, complete KYC and right-to-work checks, and manage correspondence with Swedish authorities. You will work from our Gamla Stan office in a hybrid setup, three days per week, and gain broad exposure to the engine of a fintech scaling internationally. You will have meaningful ownership over how finance, compliance and operations are documented and improved.Practical informationStockholm, hybrid. Full-time, permanent position. Office presence three days per week in Gamla Stan.Gigapay is partnering with Assistor24 on this hire to keep the process fast and transparent. We review applications as they come in and may hire before the deadline, so apply early.

title: Market Ethics Manager AstraZeneca

Then AstraZeneca might be the place for you!Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, and build close collaboration and partnerships within healthcare.Introduction to role:We are seeking a Market Ethics Manager to join the our market ethics team. In this role, you will be responsible for the scientific and market ethical review and sign-off of marketing materials, activities and relevant non-promotional initiatves.You will ensure that materials and activities comply with national rules, regulations and practices, as well as AstraZeneca internal standards. By combining strong scientific judgement with a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical ethical code, you will help cross-functional teams develop high-quality, compliant and innovative communications and activities.The role operates within the country and collaborates closely with teams across the Nordic organisation, including Medical and Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Communications, Compliance and Legal.Accountabilities:Scientific and Market Ethical Review    Perform timely scientific and market ethical review and sign-off of materials, assets and activities in accordance with applicable rules and processes.    Ensure that marketing materials, activities and relevant non-promotional initiatives comply with national requirements, local practice and AstraZeneca internal standards.    Engage relevant subject-matter experts when needed to ensure high-quality and well-informed sign-off decisions.    Apply sound judgement to optimise innovation while interpreting ethical and regulatory requirements.Guidance, Training and Capability Building    Provide practical advice, coaching and day-to-day guidance to colleagues on national market ethical rules, practices and AstraZeneca standards.    Develop and deliver training for relevant employees to strengthen understanding and consistent application of requirements.    Champion AstraZeneca ethical standards locally while supporting creativity and innovation through a deep understanding of applicable regulations.    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement company interpretations and guidance on challenging or complex compliance and ethics topics.Process, Compliance and Continuous Improvement    Stay up to date with external trends, ethical code updates and internal developments related to market ethical rules and practices.    Drive the development of market ethical practices relating to material development and activities.    Execute efficient and timely review workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational processes.    Support the preparation of technical documentation and evidence for complaint responses and appeals.    Contribute actively to the development of the function, team effectiveness and continuous improvement.    Ensure that all tasks are completed with the correct quality and in accordance with written procedures, current legal requirements and internal standards.    Maintain and further develop personal expertise within the market ethics area.Diversity & InclusionWe are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.Why AstraZeneca?At AstraZeneca, ethics and innovation go hand in hand. In this role, you will help teams navigate complex scientific, ethical and regulatory requirements while enabling high-quality communication and new ideas. Your guidance will directly support responsible decision-making and strengthen confidence in how AstraZeneca operates across the market.You will join a collaborative Nordic environment with broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape practices, build knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement across the organisation.So, what is next?Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Great, because we cannot wait to hear from you.

title: Master Thesis in Industrial design
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Do you want to help us speed up the shift towards a more sustainable mining and construction industry? By doing your thesis in collaboration with Epiroc you will get the chance to be a part of this journey. You will work together with experienced and helpful colleagues in an atmosphere characterized by creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. In your specific project you have the chance to be a part of a challenging and educational experience while growing both professionally and personally. Available Thesis Topics ⚡ Electrification How can future mining and construction sites transition to electric operations? Explore solutions for charging, energy supply, and infrastructure that enable a safe and efficient shift from fossil-fuel-powered equipment to electrified machines. 🤖 Automation UX - Human & Autonomous Systems How will people collaborate with autonomous systems in the future? Explore user experiences and interface concepts that create trust, control, and effective collaboration between operators and automated solutions. 🎮 Automation UX - Remote Operations How can we create a stronger sense of presence when operating equipment remotely? Investigate new ways of designing user interfaces that support productivity, situational awareness, and decision-making from a distance. ⛏️ Autonomous Mine - Zero Humans What would a fully autonomous mine look like? Analyze the technologies, processes, and infrastructure needed to enable mining operations with little or no human presence underground. 🌱 Sustainability & Circular Solutions How can Epiroc contribute to a more sustainable future? Explore products, services, and business opportunities that support recycling, resource efficiency, and circular material flows. 🏗️ Future Infrastructure What new business opportunities could shape Epiroc's future? Identify emerging needs within infrastructure, construction, urban development, and recycling, and propose innovative products, services, or business models. 🚀 Space Mining How could mining be performed beyond Earth? Explore concepts for mineral exploration, extraction, and maintenance in extreme environments where human presence is limited or impossible. 💡 Open Topic Have an idea of your own? Propose a thesis topic related to mining, infrastructure, sustainability, or future technologies, and develop it together with our team into a project that creates value for the industry of tomorrow. Mission: The deliverables shall be a presentation explaining the thoughts behind the proposed solutions, the work process and a scaled model. The measurement will be done by the mentors appointed for the project. The exact task for the project will be set by you and your appointed mentors. Qualification: To be successful in this project you need to have an open mind for different possible solutions. You shall also Dare-To-Think-New. Challenge established conventions in the mining industry. Education background: Master Thesis student in Industrial Design Level of thesis project: Master Thesis. Functional area: Industrial Design Recruiting manager: Bengt Parkedal, Head of Industrial Design Phone: +46(0) 10 755 16 32, 0720-832 632 Email: bengt.parkedal@epiroc.com Other contacts: Anders Sandström, Experienced Designer. Number of students in the project: One or two students/project. How to apply: Does this sound interesting, and do you feel this is a match? Log in to the recruitment system. If you are new to the system, you need to start by making a profile. Do not forget to attach your CV, Portfolio and a short letter about your-self, describing why you are applying for this thesis and, make a pitch for your project according to the topic for the master thesis. In this process, we review applications continuously and the project can be completed before last day of application. We recommend sending your application as soon possible, but no later than December 05. Please note that we do not accept applications via email

title: Junior Business System Integrations Engineer
description: Ready to kick-start your career at the intersection of systems engineering, AI, and commercial business flows? On behalf of our client, a fast-growing, globally active Swedish medtech company, Academic Work is looking for a newly graduated engineer to automate and develop business-critical systems. With close mentorship from senior architects, you will quickly grow into a key role in an international environment based in central Stockholm. Apply today—we review applications on an ongoing basis!About the roleOur client is a leading global MedTech company developing clinically researched, objective testing software for ADHD evaluation. Used by thousands of clinicians worldwide, their technology helps healthcare providers make faster, more accurate diagnoses and improve patient outcomes.As a Junior Business System Integrations Engineer, you will join a tight-knit architecture team consisting of four employees. You will receive dedicated coaching and daily support from senior architects. Your main focus will be streamlining and automating internal processes through scripting, API integrations, and system configuration rather than traditional web or app development. Acting as a bridge between technology and business, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in Finance and Commercial, as well as maintain ongoing dialogue with external system vendors. The role is based at our client’s office near Humlegården in Stockholm, following a hybrid work model where you are expected to be on-site at least three days a week.This is initially a 6-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with great opportunities for long-term employment with our client thereafterYou are offered    A unique opportunity to build valuable experience within the regulated and expanding global medtech industry.    Close mentorship and continuous support from senior architects in a welcoming, low-prestige environment.    Hands-on experience working at the forefront of modern AI tools for code generation and system automation.    An international workplace collaborating across global markets, including the UK and the US.Work tasksThis role focuses on backend development, business system integrations, and process automation rather than frontend or app development. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure data flows securely and efficiently across platforms.    Take technical ownership of the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and Salesforce.      Build and maintain integrations between business systems, the data lake, and the AWS platform using REST APIs (JSON payloads) and AWS Lambdas.      Automate manual workflows and commercial processes using Python and TypeScript scripts as well as low-code tools.      Leverage modern AI coding assistants to accelerate development, focusing on reviewing, understanding, and ensuring the quality of generated code.      Write and optimize database queries in SQL, SuiteQL, and SOQL to extract, validate, and reconcile business data.      Collaborate closely with Finance and Commercial teams to translate business requirements (from quote-to-order and contracts to usage and billing) into concrete technical solutions.      Ensure high data integrity, accurate numerical reconciliation, and strict compliance with data privacy and information security standards.      Coordinate and communicate with external system suppliers regarding ongoing integrations and system updates.We are looking for    A recently completed academic degree (M.Sc. or B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related technical field.    A solid foundation in programming (such as Python, Java, or TypeScript) and the ability to quickly grasp system architecture and codebases.    A basic understanding of commercial and financial flows, including quote-to-order, contracts, invoicing, and usage-based billing.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as English is the corporate language (Swedish is not required, though you must hold a valid work permit for Sweden).Prior experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or AWS is not required—what matters most is your technical foundation, business curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:    Business-minded and communicative: You enjoy interacting with people, feel comfortable initiating dialogue with colleagues and external vendors, and can turn vague requests into clear technical specifications.    Detail-oriented and quality-driven: You are meticulous with numbers, always double-check that data reconciles before handing it over, and respect the high standards of data privacy required in medtech.    Analytical problem-solver: You quickly understand cause and effect in complex environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Global Nuclear Standards Manager

Join us and help run what runs the world.This position reports to: Nuclear Competence Cluster Lead.Lead with Vision. Inspire with Purpose. Build a Sustainable Future. Are you ready to make your mark and drive meaningful changes on a national, regional and global scale? We’re looking for a passionate Global Nuclear Standards Manager - someone who thrives on challenge, innovation, and cross-country collaboration. Our core values - care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - guide us every day as we work to empower our people and deliver sustainable solutions. Our culture of diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities ensure everyone has a chance to contribute and succeed. appropriately addressed.     Own and continuously develop ABB’s global nuclear quality management system, standards framework and assurance model.     Lead ABB’s roadmap toward ISO 19443 readiness and procurement, manufacturing and project execution.     Establish and maintain governance for nuclear audits, corrective actions, supplier qualification, management review and continuous improvement. teams on nuclear standards, compliance and quality requirements.     Support customer audits, assessments and qualification activities including direct engagement with customers, representing ABB on nuclear quality and standards topics.     Drive nuclear safety culture and best-practice sharing across ABB’s nuclear organization.     Collaborate across Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and business teams to ensure consistent implementation of nuclear requirements globally.     You will be mainly accountable for:    Influencing and consulting with senior management across quality management, achieving high effectiveness in terms of customer satisfaction and efficiency in cost management, including processes and tools to ensure flawless and repeatable process execution, identifying gaps, and exploring opportunities for improvement.    Driving resolution of customer cases to completion, following robust root cause analysis, and implementing effective preventive and corrective actions.    Ensuring effective and efficient review of the quality management system by global leadership to sustain its continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness, and alignment with the strategic direction of the organization and to identify opportunities for improvement.What We Offer     A platform to lead with purpose and vision in a global technology leader.     The chance to shape the future of energy industries.     An inspiring and inclusive workplace culture rooted in innovation and continuous learning.     Opportunities to develop and grow, both personally and professionally. Who You Are     Relevant higher education and 10+ years of experience in quality/standard roles with the ability to develop a clear strategy      Experience working in the nuclear industry     Knowledge and understanding of regulations and authority requirements      Strong commercial acumen with experience across different go-to-market models and a proven ability to manage stakeholders and foster cross-country collaboration     A strategic thinker with demonstrated success in driving complex projects and exceptional customer outcomes     A customer-focused and results-oriented mindset, with passion for delivering through people     Excellent written and spoken communication capabilities, both internally and externally; fluent in English  *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.Ready to make an impact?Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: QA Supplier Quality Specialist
description: At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story through science, innovation, and strong partnerships. We are now looking for a QA Supplier Quality Specialist to join our Supplier Control team in Uppsala. This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal stakeholders across the organization to ensure compliance, quality, and continuous improvement throughout our supply chain.You will represent Galderma in supplier audits and quality discussions, acting as a trusted quality partner while contributing to the development of our supplier quality processes.If you enjoy building relationships, driving quality excellence, and taking ownership of complex supplier-related quality activities in a global and regulated environment, this could be the right opportunity for you. Your teamYou will join Galderma's Supplier Quality team, a collaborative and highly engaged group within Quality Assurance. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers consistently meet Galderma's quality and compliance expectations.Working closely with colleagues across QA, Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs, you will contribute to building a robust supplier network that supports both operational excellence and patient safety. Your missionAs QA Supplier Quality Specialist, your mission is to ensure that Galderma's suppliers and external partners operate in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. Through proactive supplier oversight, audits, quality agreements, and continuous improvement initiatives, you will help safeguard product quality throughout the supply chain.You will act as a trusted quality partner, representing Galderma in supplier interactions and helping to strengthen the quality culture both internally and externally. Key Responsibilities    Manage supplier qualification, supplier control, and supplier lifecycle activities.    Plan, conduct, and follow up quality audits of suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers.    Represent Galderma during supplier audits and quality reviews.    Act as a key point of contact for supplier quality-related questions and support suppliers in meeting Galderma's quality expectations.    Analyze audit outcomes, identify compliance gaps related to GMP and GDP requirements, and ensure timely follow-up of observations and corrective actions.    Review and manage supplier change notifications and assess potential quality impacts.    Investigate and manage deviations related to materials and external services.    Establish, maintain, and update quality agreements with suppliers and business partners.    Drive continuous improvements within supplier quality processes and programs.    Collaborate closely with Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other Quality functions to ensure robust supplier oversight.    Build strong and sustainable relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Your profileWe are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance professional who enjoys working in a role with a high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and external exposure. As a trusted representative of Galderma, you will interact closely with suppliers and partners, lead quality discussions, and contribute to building strong and sustainable supplier relationships.You are comfortable taking ownership of complex quality matters, investigating issues, and driving activities through to completion. At the same time, you understand the importance of collaboration and are able to build strong relationships across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and self-driven professional who combines a structured and analytical approach with sound judgement and a continuous improvement mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by delivering high-quality results. Required Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality Management, or another relevant field.· Several years of experience working within a GMP-regulated environment.· Experience from the pharmaceutical industry.· Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.· Strong knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements.· Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive activities to completion.· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Preferred Qualifications    Experience planning, conducting, and following up supplier audits.    Experience representing a company during external audits and supplier quality reviews.    Experience with supplier qualification programs and supplier lifecycle management.    Experience from Quality Assurance. Location and informationThis position is based onsite in Uppsala, Sweden. The role includes regular travel within Europe to supplier sites and business partners. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio

title: Mechanical Development Engineer - Electrical Integration Focus
description: A Snapshot of Your DayJoin our open-minded team where collaboration and support are at the heart of what we do! In this dynamic role, you will engage in designing structural and layout solutions for our gas turbine packages, producing manufacturing data in Siemens NX along with essential technical documentation. You will play a crucial role in strengthening our capability within electrical integration by working closely with the Electrical Engineering department. Your efforts will support the placement and routing of electrical installations, such as junction boxes, cable trays, conduits, and cable routing within our NX environment. This position offers a unique opportunity to blend traditional Structure & Layout work with a growing specialization in electrical integration, helping to shape future methodologies alongside our electrical experts.How You’ll Make an Impact    Design structural and layout solutions for gas turbine packages while producing manufacturing data and technical documentation in Siemens NX.    Develop and maintain 3D layouts, installation concepts, and design documentation for package structures and equipment arrangements.    Drive the integration of electrical installations within the package layout, including junction boxes, cable routing, cable trays, conduits, and installation supports.    Collaborate closely with Electrical Engineering to ensure electrical solutions are efficiently incorporated into the overall product design.    Participate in the development and maintenance of product standards, design guidelines, and best practices within Structure & Layout and electrical integration.    Work with procurement, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams to develop robust, cost-effective, and manufacturable technical solutions.    Support development projects and customer orders by delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements, schedules, and quality expectations.    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on electrical routing methodologies, NX design processes, and installation concepts.What You Bring    A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.    Proficiency in Siemens NX for design and documentation.    Experience in structural design and layout, particularly in the context of gas turbine packages.    Relevant knowledge of electrical systems, including familiarity with electrical integration concepts and installation practices.    Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.    A commitment to delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements.    Advanced English proficiency is required.About the TeamThe Structure & Layout team consists of 19 skilled engineers specializing in structural engineering and layout design for complex energy projects. Organized into two collaborative teams, we foster a close-knit and supportive work environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual support are key to our success. We place a strong emphasis on personal and professional development, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to grow. This commitment to quality and continuous improvement creates a culture where individuals thrive while delivering high-quality solutions.Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.ApplicationDon’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 307247 not later than 2026-12-09.Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.Location: FinspångTrade Union Representatives:Unionen, unionen.finspang.se@siemens-energy.comSveriges Ingenjörer & SACO, asi.se@siemens-energy.comLedarna, Anders Fors, ledarnaklubbenseab@siemens-energy.comIF Metall, Mikael Malmgren, mikael.malmgren@siemens-energy.com#LI-MN1

title: IPR Coordinator
description: Do you enjoy precise, well-organized work, and are you curious about how innovations are protected?Are you curious about technology, innovation, and how groundbreaking ideas are protected? Join our global IPR team as an IPR Coordinator and become a key part of the journey from invention disclosure to granted patents around the world. In this role, you will work at the intersection of technology, intellectual property, and international collaboration, connecting inventors, patent engineers, R&D, Legal teams, and external patent agents. You will help ensure that valuable innovations are captured, protected, and managed efficiently while contributing to process development and data quality within a global organization. This role offers flexibility in location and can be based at one of our main offices in Sweden or Finland, with a preference for Karlstad in Sweden. Your responsibilities     You will coordinate invention disclosures, register new matters in our IP management system, and work closely with inventors, patent engineers, and R&D teams throughout the innovation process.     You will manage patent, trademark, utility model, and design filings by collaborating with inventors, external patent agents, and international stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.     You will maintain and develop our patent portfolio, monitor deadlines, coordinate office actions, and help secure high-quality intellectual property protection worldwide.     You will support competitor monitoring activities and perform searches in international patent databases to help provide valuable patent information.     You will manage IPR-related documentation, agreements, invoices, reporting, and data quality while supporting continuous improvements within the IPR function. Expectations for you     You have a relevant post-secondary education and/or experience in administration, coordination, or a similar role.     You have experience from IPR, legal services, or technology-intensive environments, or a strong motivation to develop expertise within intellectual property.     You are comfortable working with digital systems, data management, reporting, and process improvement activities.     You have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.     You have advanced written and spoken Swedish and English proficiency. To succeed in this role Success in this position requires organizational skills, a structured way of working, and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines. You are comfortable coordinating stakeholders simultaneously and enjoy working in an international environment where accuracy and collaboration are essential. Your curiosity about technology and intellectual property, combined with a service-minded approach and strong digital skills, will help you create value across the organization. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:     Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through     Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly     Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety     Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value We offer You will join a global IPR function that works closely with R&D, Legal, and business teams across multiple countries. You will gain hands-on insight into the world of patents, trademarks, and innovation protection while working alongside experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge. The role provides opportunities to develop your IPR expertise, improve processes and systems, and contribute to how intellectual property is managed globally. At Valmet, you will find an inspiring and collaborative work environment where innovation and sustainability go hand in hand. We support your professional development through learning opportunities, flexible working arrangements, and competitive employee benefits. You will work with modern tools, international colleagues, and meaningful technologies that help industries move toward a more sustainable future. Want to know more? If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 6, by filling in our online application form. For further information about the position, please contact Ari Malkasaari, Director, IPR at ari.malkasaari@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. When everything works together  Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. title: Senior Fraud Specialist
description: Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!About the roleAs Senior Fraud Specialist, you will play a central role in our efforts to prevent, detect and investigate fraudulent activity across our Swedish and Finnish markets.You will take ownership of complex and high-exposure fraud investigations, make independent decisions within your mandate and act as a senior point of expertise for the team. In addition to your operational responsibilities, you will provide quality assurance through four-eyes reviews, support and coach colleagues, and contribute to improving our fraud detection rules and processes.Working closely with the Head of AFC, Fraud Specialists, Operations, Customer Care and AML, you will help ensure that we maintain strong controls while continuously adapting to new and evolving fraud patterns.This is a senior specialist position with professional leadership responsibilities, but no formal line-management responsibility.Key responsibilities    Lead complex fraud investigations, including account takeovers, APP scams, mule networks, organized fraud and cross-border transactions.    Make independent decisions on fraud cases, including account blocks, contract terminations and police reports within your mandate.    Perform four-eyes reviews and quality assurance of investigations and decisions made by other Fraud Specialists.    Identify emerging fraud trends and typologies, translating insights into improvements in our fraud prevention capabilities.    Lead the preparation, testing and documentation of changes to our Hawk AI detection rules and monitoring models.    Analyze transaction data and detection performance to identify opportunities to improve our controls.    Act as a subject matter expert, supporting and coaching colleagues in investigative methods, fraud typologies and documentation.    Prepare fraud reporting and support regulatory reporting requirements.    Collaborate with internal stakeholders, other financial institutions and law enforcement when needed.Who you areWe believe you are an experienced fraud professional who combines strong investigative capabilities with sound judgement and a structured approach to decision-making. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex situations, making independent assessments and guiding others through challenging cases.You are analytical, detail-oriented and curious about how fraud patterns evolve. At the same time, you understand the importance of balancing risk management, customer experience and commercial considerations.You also enjoy sharing your knowledge, challenging existing ways of working and helping a team continuously improve.What we are looking for    At least four years of experience in fraud prevention, fraud detection or financial crime, with substantial hands-on experience in operational fraud investigations.    Strong knowledge of fraud typologies such as account takeover, APP scams, SIM swapping, bust-out fraud, mule networks and business email compromise.    Experience working with automated fraud monitoring systems, ideally Hawk AI, including detection rules, testing and calibration.    Understanding of transaction monitoring, device intelligence and session intelligence.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently investigate and assess transaction data.    Experience reviewing colleagues' work, providing guidance or training others is highly valued.    Good understanding of relevant financial regulations, payment services legislation, AML requirements and data protection.    Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.A university degree in Law, Economics, Finance, Business Administration, Data Analysis or a related field is preferred, but equivalent professional experience is equally relevant.What we offerAt Northmill, you'll be part of a fast-moving and entrepreneurial environment where technology, innovation and people come together. We believe in taking ownership, challenging conventions and making a real impact.You'll join a collaborative team where your expertise matters, your ideas are encouraged and you have the opportunity to influence how we protect our customers and develop our business.    A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views    An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact    Great opportunities for professional development    Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance    Conference abroad every other year    Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday    Regular after work and celebrated successes at the officeApply today and be a part of Northmill!Background ChecksAs a bank, we place great importance on trust, security and integrity. As part of our recruitment process, we therefore conduct background checks on candidates in the final stages of the recruitment process. These checks form part of our commitment to maintaining a safe, secure and compliant business.

title: INFORMATIONSSÄKERHETSANSVARIG - LÖFAB
description: Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.Vill du ta ett strategiskt och operativt ansvar för informationssäkerhet, dataskydd, GDPR och cybersäkerhet i en verksamhet där säkerhet är en avgörande framgångsfaktor?I takt med att digitaliseringen ökar ställs allt högre krav på säker hantering av information, robusta processer och efterlevnad av lagar och regelverk. Därför söker vi nu en Informationssäkerhetsansvarig som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla, samordna och stärka vårt arbete inom informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och cybersäkerhet.Det här är en nyckelroll för dig som vill kombinera strategiskt arbete med operativt genomförande och som trivs med att skapa struktur, driva förändring och bygga en stark säkerhetskultur i hela organisationen.Om rollenSom Informationssäkerhetsansvarig får du det övergripande ansvaret för att utveckla, förvalta och följa upp företagets arbete inom informationssäkerhet och dataskydd. Du säkerställer att verksamheten arbetar enligt fastställda regelverk, processer och riktlinjer samtidigt som du driver utvecklingen framåt för att möta nya krav och hotbilder.Du leder arbetet med informationsklassningar, riskanalyser och konsekvensbedömningar samt samordnar företagets arbete inom dataskydd och GDPR. En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla och förvalta strukturer för informations- och dokumenthantering, där du säkerställer att information hanteras, lagras och gallras på ett korrekt och säkert sätt.Du fungerar som ett stöd till verksamheten i frågor som rör dokumentstyrning, informationshantering och regelefterlevnad. I rollen ingår också att planera och genomföra utbildningar, workshops och övningar som stärker organisationens kunskap och medvetenhet inom informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och cybersäkerhet.Som ansvarig för företagets cybersäkerhetsarbete bevakar du löpande omvärlden och håller verksamheten informerad om aktuella hot, sårbarheter och risker. Du driver förbättringsinitiativ, samordnar säkerhetsinsatser och bidrar med kvalificerad rådgivning till både ledning och verksamhet.Organisationsmässigt är rollen organiserad i säkerhetsteamet och du rapporterar till Director of Security. Vid säkerhetsincidenter är du en central resurs som stöttar verksamheten, samordnar insatser och följer upp förbättringsåtgärder. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, IT-funktioner och externa samarbetspartners för att säkerställa att företaget har en stark och hållbar säkerhetsförmåga över tid.Du är:Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, riskhantering, dataskydd, GDPR, cybersäkerhet och som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla och stärka verksamhetens säkerhetsarbete.Du har en god förståelse för hur säkerhetsfrågor behöver integreras i verksamheten för att skapa verklig affärsnytta och långsiktig hållbarhet. Du är van att omsätta regelverk och krav till praktiska arbetssätt och känner dig trygg i dialogen med såväl ledning som medarbetare.Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att genomföra riskanalyser, informationsklassningar, konsekvensbedömningar och arbete med efterlevnadsfrågor. Du är analytisk och strukturerad samtidigt som du har förmågan att driva frågor framåt och skapa engagemang hos människor omkring dig.Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete enligt ISO 27001, ISO 27002 och ISO 27005 samt kunskap inom cybersäkerhet, incidenthantering och säkerhetsskyddsarbete. Erfarenhet av säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning och arbete i säkerhetskänsliga verksamheter är också ett plus.Som person är du pedagogisk, kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen, samtidigt som du är självständig och trygg i att fatta välgrundade beslut inom ditt ansvarsområde.Du får:Hos oss får du en central och verksamhetsnära roll där du får möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och stärka företagets arbete inom informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och cybersäkerhet.Du kommer att arbeta i en organisation som ser säkerhet som en strategisk fråga och som investerar långsiktigt i både teknik, processer och kompetens. Här får du möjlighet att bygga strukturer, driva förbättringar och skapa förutsättningar för en säker och hållbar verksamhet.Samtidigt blir du en del av en organisation med korta beslutsvägar, engagerade kollegor och en kultur som präglas av ansvarstagande, samarbete och utveckling.Välkommen till ossHär får du möjlighet att kombinera strategi, verksamhetsutveckling och säkerhetsarbete i en roll där du gör verklig skillnad för organisationens framtid.Välkommen med din ansökan!Är du den Informationssäkerhetsansvarige vi söker? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Säkerhetsprövning kommer att ske innan anställning. Godkänd säkerhetsprövning krävs för anställning.Ansvarig rekryterare är P-A Karlsson på FSK Group.Vi är FSK Group – The Generator, ett bolag som driver utveckling och tillväxt genom våra tre affärsområden Talent, Brand och Growth.Talent – Vi hjälper framåtlutade företag att hitta rätt människor, framför allt inom Management, Sales och Marketing.Brand – Vi stärker varumärken genom Employer Branding och Business Branding.Growth – Vi skapar inspirerande och utmanande utbildningar som utvecklar företag för framtiden.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chef de Partie---Chef de Partie============== **Chef de Partie** **Permanent contract** / Crans\-Montana, SwitzerlandLes Roches, part of Sommet Education group, is a globally renowned institution shaping the future of hospitality and the experience economy through transformative and experiential education in 3 campuses: Crans\-Montana (Switzerland), Marbella (Spain) and Dhabi (UAE).2nd in the 2026 QS World University Ranking in Hospitality and Leisure Management and 2nd in employer reputation category.Accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE) and Swiss Accreditation Council (SAC) as a University of Applied Sciences Institute.Les Roches Marbella, certified ISO\-14001 and ISO\-9001\.Our values, *Development, Distinctiveness, Joint Commitment, Openness and Sense of Service*, are the foundation of our actions. We offer an innovative, collaborative and thriving environment. **Mission**  The Chef de Partie is responsible for the preparation, production, and presentation of food within an assigned kitchen section. Working under the supervision of the Executive Sous\-Chef and Kitchen Sous\-Chef, the role ensures the consistent application of culinary standards, food safety requirements, and operational procedures.  As part of Les Roches' experiential learning environment, the Chef de Partie supports students during practical sessions by demonstrating professional culinary techniques and fostering a culture of excellence, professionalism, and hospitality. **Main Responsibilities  1\. Execute Food Production Activities**  \- Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes, production plans, and quality standards.  \- Ensure consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control.  \- Contribute to the smooth operation of daily kitchen activities within the assigned section.   **2\. Support Student Practical Training**  \- Assist students during practical kitchen sessions and operational service periods.  \- Demonstrate culinary techniques, kitchen organization, and professional work methods.  \- Promote discipline, teamwork, and compliance with operational standards.   **3\. Ensure Hygiene and Food Safety Compliance**  \- Maintain full compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and internal procedures.  \- Ensure cleanliness and organization of workstations, equipment, and storage areas.  \- Report any food safety or operational concerns to supervisors.   **4\. Maintain Kitchen Organization and Resources**  \- Assist with the proper storage, rotation, and handling of food products.  \- Support inventory counts and the monitoring of stock levels.  \- Contribute to reducing food waste and ensuring responsible use of resources.   **5\. Contribute to Operational Excellence**  \- Collaborate effectively with kitchen colleagues, instructors, and service teams.  \- Support special events, functions, and academic activities as required.  \- Actively contribute to maintaining a professional, positive, and guest\-focused kitchen environment. **Key Competencies**  Strong culinary fundamentals and technical cooking skills.  understanding of food safety and HACCP requirements.  Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.  Strong attention to detail and quality standards.  Team\-oriented mindset and collaborative approach.  Ability to support and guide students through example.  Flexibility and adaptability in a multicultural environment. **Key Indicators**  Compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.  Quality and consistency of food production.  Preparedness and organization of assigned kitchen section.  Student and instructor satisfaction during practical activities.  Contribution to waste reduction and proper stock management.  Reliability and teamwork within kitchen operations.* Rte des Moulinettes 2 3975 Crans\-Montana*** Rte des Moulinettes 2 3975 Crans\-Montana**jida6c1b0bjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Sous Chef  100% ohne Zimmerstunde
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Sous Chef (m/w/d) 100% ohne Zimmerstunde--- Sous Chef (m/w/d) 100% ohne Zimmerstunde========================================**Lust auf Gastronomie mit Adrenalin?**  Vergiss verstaubte Gastro\-Standards: Bei der  **Hospitality AG** mit Sitz in Arlesheim BL kreieren wir Erlebnisse, die im Gedächtnis bleiben! Als eines der schweizweit führenden Event\-Cateringunternehmen erwecken wir einzigartige Konzepte zum Leben – von stilvollen Galas und exklusiven Corporate Events über bebende Grossveranstaltungen mit bis zu 6'500 Gästen bis hin zu coolen Streetfood\-Projekten. Ob in unseren eigenen Eventlocations oder bei unseren Kunden vor Ort.  Wir verbinden die Stärke eines Marktführers mit der Freiheit und Dynamik eines modernen Lifestyle\-Betriebs. Bei uns erwartet dich kein starrer Trott, sondern ein junges, ambitioniertes Team mit echter Hands\-on\-Mentalität: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken anders und bringen Spitzenleistung dorthin, wo gefeiert wird. Du suchst einen Ort, an dem du deine Energie voll einbringen, aktiv mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit uns über dich hinauswachsen kannst? Willkommen in der Welt von !  Die  **Hospitality** gehört zur  **Enterprise AG**. Unter deren Dach sind zwei weitere Unternehmen tätig. Neben dem Eventbereich sind wir auch im Backoffice stark:  **Treuhand****GmbH** betreut Mandate aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und sorgt für Ordnung und Durchblick – von der Finanzbuchhaltung über das Controlling bis zum Personalwesen.   **Konzepte GmbH** agiert als strategischer Impulsgeber, unterstützt Unternehmen beim Business Development und entwickelt innovative Gastro\-Konzepte, die weit über den Tellerrand hinausreichen.  ***Du willst nicht nur am Herd stehen, sondern die kulinarische Zukunft der Schweizer Eventbranche aktiv mitgestalten?***  In unserer Küche erwartet dich keine verstaubte Routine: Wir tüfteln an innovativen Food\-Konzepten, rocken gemeinsam die grössten Events des Landes und schaffen Momente, die in Erinnerung bleiben.  Du bist eine Sous\-Chef\-Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Führungs\-, Organisations\- und Executive\-Erfahrung, hast tiefes Gourmet\-Verständnis und suchst eine echte Schlüsselrolle als rechte Hand unseres Chef de Cuisine – und das ganz ohne mühsame Zimmerstunde? Dann bist du bei der Hospitality genau richtig!  Als   **Sous Chef / Sous Chef (m/w/d)****100 %** bildest du gemeinsam mit einem zweiten Sous Chef das starke Führungsduo direkt an der Seite unseres Chef de Cuisine. Du übernimmst Mitverantwortung für die operative Küchenleitung, die administrative Planung und die Führung unseres Kernteams sowie der variablen Saison\-Crew.  **Deine Aufgaben bei uns:**  * **Rechte Hand des Chef de Cuisine:** Du unterstützt unseren Küchenchef aktiv bei der Planung, Organisation und Konzeptentwicklung. Bei seiner Abwesenheit übernimmst du die Gesamtleitung in Vertretung des Küchenchef.  * **Operative Unterstützung \& Team\-Anleitung**: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Küchenchef und dem zweiten Sous Chef zusammen. Gemeinsam leitet ihr unser festes Kernteam von 6 Mitarbeitenden (davon 2 Lernende) in der der Cateringproduktion und an Eventeinsätzen.  * **Flexibles Saison\-Team**: Je nach Saison, Event\-Volumen und Auslastung packst du stärker im Operativen Geschäft mit an und stellst die Einarbeitung und Anleitung unserer variablen Mitarbeitenden sicher.  * **Qualität \& Gourmet\-Gefühl:** Du stellst sicher, dass jedes Gericht – von exklusiven Business\-Caterings bis hin zu eindrucksvollen Grossveranstaltungen – geschmacklich und optisch höchsten Gourmet\-Ansprüchen genügt.  * **Planung \& Admin:** Du hast die administrativen Abläufe im Griff (Dienstplanung, Produktionsplanung, Rezeptur\-Standardisierung, Einhaltung von HACCP\- und Hygiene\-Richtlinien usw.) und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe vor Ort.  * **Event\- \& Catering\-Einsätze:** Du packst bei Caterings und Events in der ganzen Schweiz aktiv mit an – in unseren eigenen Locations und bei unseren Kunden vor Ort.  ### Voraussetzungen* **Ausbildung \& Praxis:** Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Koch EFZ sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Gourmet/Sternegastronomie.  * **Catering\- \& Event\-Erfahrung:** Optimalerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus dem Event\-Cateringbereich mit und behältst auch bei hoher Dynamik den kühlen .  * **Leadership \& Organisation:** Du bringst umfassende Führungserfahrung mit, hast bereits grössere Teams geleitet und die administrative Planung und Organisation eigenständig verantwortet. Du hast Erfahrung darin, variable Mitarbeitende bei saisonalen Spitzen als Verstärkung des Stammteams klar anzuleiten und einheitliche Standards sicherzustellen.  * **Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit:** Du bist eine mitreissende, kommunikative und gewinnende Persönlichkeit – kurz: eine echte Macher\-Natur, die gerne vorne steht, ihr Team begeistert und nicht im Hintergrund verschwindet.  * **Sprachkompetenz:** Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse für die reibungslose Kommunikation im multinationalen Team.  ### Vorteile* **Keine Zimmerstunde:** Bei uns arbeitest du in durchgehenden Einsätzen statt gestückelten Arbeitstagen. Kein stundenlanges Warten zwischen den Schichten – damit deine freie Zeit auch wirklich deine Zeit bleibt.  * **Betriebsferien:** Zwei Wochen Betriebsferien im sowie zwei Wochen über Weihnachten und Neujahr für deine Erholung sind immer gesetzt.  * **Top\- \& Infrastruktur:** Moderner Arbeitsplatz auf dem dynamischen Areal in Arlesheim direkt am Naherholungsgebiet der Birs (perfekt für die Pause am ). Genügend Parkplätze vor Ort und beste ÖV\-Anbindung.  * **Starker Teamgeist:** Dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Du\-Kultur und Teamevents, die zusammenschweissen.     **Bereit, an der Spitze unserer Küche mitzugestalten?**  uns deine ***vollständige*** Bewerbung und bring deine Erfahrung bei Hospitality ein!  ![ Enterprise AG]()* Enterprise AG  Hauptstrasse 23  4142 Münchenstein*jid53c9acdjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Planificateur PDP
description: Ref 2591467 \| Date: 16 Nov 2026![ValJob Genève]( )![]( )![]( ) **Vous êtes à la recherche d’un nouveau challenge ? ValJob, active depuis 1995 dans le placement et les services en Ressources Humaines, est une société suisse leader, reconnue et appréciée pour la qualité de ses services et la haute performance de ses collaborateurs. Nous recherchons pour l’un de nos clients le profil suivant :****Planificateur PDP (H/F)**===========================**Votre mission :  Votre prochain défi  Vous avez une solide compréhension des enjeux de planification industrielle et souhaitez contribuer à la performance d'un environnement de production exigeant ?  Pour accompagner notre client dans le développement et le pilotage de ses activités, ValJob recherche un(e) Planificateur PDP (H/F) pour sa division Production.  Au cœur des flux industriels, vous serez responsable de la construction des programmes directeurs de production et du suivi de leur exécution. Votre capacité à anticiper les besoins, coordonner les différents interlocuteurs et optimiser les ressources sera essentielle pour garantir le respect des objectifs de livraison.    Vos tâches / responsabilités  • Construire, ajuster et faire valider les programmes directeurs de production, puis contrôler leur bonne exécution.  • Planifier et suivre les capacités industrielles ainsi que les niveaux de stocks, en tenant compte des orientations stratégiques et des contraintes opérationnelles.  • Définir et déployer des indicateurs de performance afin d'assurer le suivi et la communication des activités de planification.  • Veiller à l'application des processus de gestion pour garantir la cohérence, la qualité et la fiabilité des plans établis.  • Intégrer les variations de la demande client ainsi que les évolutions liées aux nouveaux produits et aux nouveaux processus.  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents services de production afin de maintenir les objectifs de livraison.  • Repérer les écarts par rapport aux prévisions, analyser leurs conséquences et proposer des mesures d'ajustement adaptées.****Votre profil :  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur HES ou EPF, avec une spécialisation en logistique de production, ou disposez d'une formation équivalente. (Impératif)  • Vous possédez idéalement une première expérience ou une expérience confirmée dans les domaines de la planification ou de la Supply Chain.  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et savez instaurer des relations professionnelles fondées sur la confiance.  • Vous faites preuve d'écoute, de leadership et d'un excellent esprit de collaboration.  • Votre communication est claire et structurée, et vous savez défendre vos propositions avec pertinence.    Vos compétences  • Bonne maîtrise d'un ERP.  • Bonnes connaissances d'un outil décisionnel.  • Capacité à analyser les données de planification, identifier les écarts et évaluer leurs impacts.  • Aptitude à construire et exploiter des indicateurs de suivi et de performance.  • Excellente capacité de synthèse pour traiter et communiquer les informations essentielles.  • Maîtrise de la gestion des priorités dans un environnement impliquant plusieurs contraintes de production.  • Capacité à coordonner les interfaces entre les services et à proposer des solutions correctives adaptées.    De préférence, être domicilié(e) en Suisse.    Votre expérience dans un autre secteur ?  Vous avez acquis votre expérience en planification au sein d'un autre environnement industriel, tel que l'aéronautique, l'automobile, les industries pharmaceutique et médicale, l'industrie de pointe ou encore le secteur technologique ? Vous avez également évolué dans une organisation Supply Chain différente ? Votre parcours peut tout à fait correspondre à nos attentes !  Votre expérience en gestion des capacités, pilotage des stocks, coordination des flux et suivi des programmes de production peut représenter un véritable atout. Les compétences acquises dans d'autres secteurs industriels peuvent parfaitement être valorisées dans cette fonction.    Nous vous proposons  • L'opportunité d'occuper une fonction transversale au sein d'une division Production.  • Un rôle impliquant des responsabilités directes dans le pilotage des programmes de production et le respect des engagements de livraison.    Intéressé(e) ?  Vous souhaitez mettre vos connaissances en planification industrielle au service d'un environnement de production stimulant et contribuer à la maîtrise des flux et des capacités ?  N'attendez plus pour nous transmettre votre candidature et saisir cette opportunité professionnelle !    ValJob – Votre partenaire pour les métiers de la production et de la Supply Chain.** **jpid1f74e46jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm**

We do this by selectively collaborating with leading pharma and biotech companies and fostering a culture of innovation that allows us to maintain our leadership position in the space. If you find that inspiring, we want to work with you!  **Position Summary**  Genevant has an opportunity for an experienced, practical and commercially minded Director/Senior Director, Contracts and Transactions, to join our Legal team. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO), this role will provide legal and transactional support across the organization, with a particular focus on research and development\-related contracts and technology licenses and collaborations. The ideal candidate will thrive working independently to manage and execute on the day\-to\-day contracting required to keep a biopharma business moving, with the ability to grow into a leadership role for complex business negotiations.  The successful candidate will work closely with the CLO, senior leadership, Business Development, R\&D, Procurement, Finance, and other functional leaders and is comfortable participating in and guiding executive level business/legal discussions. The position is available at our office in Basel, Switzerland, and will work collaboratively with our other offices in Canada (Vancouver) and the United States (Boston).  **Responsibilities:*** Draft, review, negotiate and otherwise manage the contracting process for a wide variety of contracts, including research and development\-related agreements, software licenses and other G\&A agreements, to align with Genevant’s objectives.* Support the CLO and other members of senior leadership and grow into a leadership role in the negotiation and preparation of complex technology licenses and collaborations.* Maintain a well functioning contract management system.* Support contract lifecycle management, including tracking agreements, renewals, amendments, extension and key dates.* Act as a trusted legal business partner who provides practical, business\-oriented legal advice and explains complex legal issues in clear, understandable terms.* Help internal teams understand contractual commitments, risks, and negotiation priorities.* Manage other legal\-related responsibilities as assigned by the CLO.**Requirements, Knowledge, skills, and abilities:*** Juris Doctor from a recognized law school.* 2\-6 years of relevant experience in\-house / law firm experience in a contracts or general corporate role, preferably within the life sciences industry.* Experience with complex pharma collaborations is a plus.* Strong communication and executive presence, with credibility at the senior leadership level.* Proven experience in contract negotiation and management, with the ability to lead the process independently end\-to\-end.* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in fast\-paced, dynamic environments.* Strong business acumen with sound judgment in integrating legal advice with business objectives.* Admitted to practice law in Switzerland and in good standing with the competent cantonal Bar Association.* Need to interact with colleagues in Eastern Time Zone (6\-hour time difference) and Pacific Time Zone (9\-hour time difference); may require worktime travel may be required.**Benefits \& Compensation**  We’ve worked to create an environment at Genevant that makes our people feel empowered, supported and appreciated so they can focus on doing incredible work that can change the future. To that end, we offer competitive salaries, performance bonus opportunity, good social benefits as well as the opportunity to work on a cooperative corporate culture, flexible working time, remote position and generous vacation package.![Genevant Sciences GmbH]()* Genevant Sciences GmbH  Viaduktstrasse 8  4051 Basel*jid6716c41jm jit1147jm jiy26jm
