title: Portfolio Strategy & Transformation Lead (100%)
description: Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.About the role:We are looking for a Portfolio Strategy & Transformation Lead (100%) to join our Global Portfolio Management team within the Flow division in Switzerland. In this high-impact role, you will help transform portfolio management into a strategic business capability across the Water & Industrial Business Unit (WIBU), enabling data-driven decision-making, profitable growth, and long-term portfolio optimization.You will establish portfolio governance, performance transparency, product hierarchy ownership, lifecycle management practices, and strategic portfolio steering processes. Working across functions and senior stakeholder groups, you will play a key role in shaping the future direction of our portfolio and driving business transformation.Your main tasks and responsibilities:•    Own and evolve the Product Hierarchy framework by driving the WIBU Product Hierarchy program, ensuring clear ownership, consistent product classification, improved master data quality, and successful milestone delivery. •    Establish portfolio performance management capabilities, including KPI frameworks, dashboards, reporting standards, and review mechanisms that provide reliable product-level business insights and transparency. •    Drive strategic portfolio steering by developing and facilitating portfolio review processes that support investment decisions, lifecycle management, portfolio optimization, resource allocation, and growth initiatives. •    Generate market, competitive, and portfolio intelligence by consolidating insights on market trends, customer needs, competitive developments, portfolio gaps, and emerging business opportunities in collaboration with segment, product management, and development teams. •    Lead portfolio transformation initiatives related to portfolio governance, lifecycle excellence, digitalization, product master data, performance and pricing management, and process harmonization across the organization. •    Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders, enabling fact-based portfolio decisions and fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.To succeed in this role, you will need: •    Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; an MBA is a strong plus. •    5-8 years of experience in portfolio management, strategy, business transformation, product management, or a related function within an industrial or manufacturing environment. •    Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex market, portfolio, and business data into actionable recommendations.•    Experience driving cross-functional transformation initiatives involving product management, commercial functions, operations, R&D, and senior leadership.•    Strong change management and project management skills with a track record of driving business improvement and transformation. •    Digital mindset with experience using analytics and reporting tools to drive performance management and business insights. •    Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.What we offer you: •    An innovative, vibrant and agile culture•    Excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.) •    Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle•    Central workplace, only 5 minutes from Winterthur train stationSulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI - Direction générale
employer: Hospice général, institution genevoise d'action sociale
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI - Direction générale--- Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI \- Direction générale==========================================================**Description de l'entreprise****A l’Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève**Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d’un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l’aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l’asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d’intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l’isolement des seniors.Nous sommes plus de 1’600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40’ 000 personnes.En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l’inclusion, nous valorisons l’intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l’innovation et favorisons la prise d’initiative et l’expérimentation.**Description du poste****Votre mission**À la tête de l’institution, vous donnez le cap et créez les conditions permettant à l’Hospice général de remplir durablement ses missions de service public.En lien étroit avec le Conseil d’administration, ainsi qu’avec le département de tutelle, vous traduisez les orientations stratégiques en priorités institutionnelles et veillez à leur réalisation. Vous conduisez la Direction générale, composée notamment de la Direction générale adjointe et du Secrétariat général, et vous vous appuyez sur le Comité de direction pour assurer la cohérence, la performance et la capacité d’adaptation de l’ensemble de l’institution, pour apporter une réponse adaptée et coordonnée aux besoins des personnes qui font appel à l’Hospice général.Vous représentez l’Hospice général auprès des autorités cantonales, de ses partenaires et des principales parties prenantes. Vous portez sa mission, ses positions, ses valeurs et ses enjeux dans un environnement social, politique et institutionnel en évolution permanente.**Vos principales responsabilités**Vous aurez notamment pour responsabilité de:* élaborer les orientations stratégiques de l’Hospice général avec le Conseil d’administration, ainsi qu’avec le département de tutelle, et en assurer la mise en œuvre ;* vous appuyer sur le Secrétariat général pour garantir une gouvernance solide, le fonctionnement des instances, la maîtrise des risques et la qualité des dispositifs de contrôle ;* assurer, avec la Direction générale adjointe, le pilotage global de l’activité, la cohérence entre les directions et la mise en œuvre des décisions institutionnelles ;* animer une Direction générale et un Comité de direction capables d’arbitrer, de prioriser et d’agir collectivement ;* conduire l’institution dans une logique de service public, de qualité des prestations, d’efficience et de responsabilité ;* anticiper les évolutions sociales, politiques, légales, économiques et technologiques susceptibles d’influencer ses missions ;* créer les conditions permettant aux directions et aux équipes d’exercer leurs responsabilités avec autonomie, exigence et coopération ;* garantir une allocation maîtrisée des ressources humaines, financières, immobilières et numériques ;* entretenir une relation de confiance et de transparence avec le Conseil d’administration et ses comités ;* représenter l’Hospice général dans ses relations avec le Conseil d’État, le conseil, le département de tutelle, les communes, les institutions partenaires et les autres acteurs\-trices du réseau ;* porter la parole de l’institution dans les situations stratégiques, sensibles ou de crise ;* accompagner les transformations nécessaires tout en préservant la continuité et la qualité des prestations aux personnes accompagnées.**Qualifications****Votre profil**Vous disposez d’une formation universitaire supérieure ou d’un parcours jugé équivalent, complétée par une formation en management, gouvernance publique ou conduite d’organisation.Vous pouvez vous prévaloir d’une expérience confirmée de direction générale ou de direction exécutive au sein d’une organisation complexe, idéalement dans le secteur public, parapublic ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé.Votre parcours démontre votre capacité à :* définir une vision et la traduire en décisions et résultats concrets ;* piloter une organisation de grande taille et des transformations complexes ;* travailler avec un Conseil d’administration et dans un environnement de gouvernance publique ;* comprendre les enjeux politiques et institutionnels sans perdre de vue les réalités opérationnelles ;* arbitrer et décider dans des situations comportant des intérêts ou contraintes parfois divergents ;* fédérer des cadres dirigeant·es et développer une véritable responsabilité collective ;* établir des relations solides avec des partenaires institutionnels et politiques ;* communiquer avec clarté, y compris dans des contextes sensibles ;* conjuguer exigence de performance, qualité du service public et attention portée aux personnes.Votre leadership repose sur la clarté, la confiance et la responsabilisation. Vous savez écouter et associer, mais également décider lorsque la situation l’exige. Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement exposé, où les décisions doivent pouvoir être expliquées, assumées et mises en œuvre.Une connaissance approfondie du fonctionnement des institutions publiques genevoises et des politiques sociales constitue un atout important.**Informations supplémentaires****Ce que nous vous proposons**Une fonction au cœur des enjeux sociaux du canton de Genève, avec la possibilité d’agir concrètement sur l’évolution d’une institution publique majeure.Vous rejoindrez une organisation engagée dans une transformation de son fonctionnement, de ses pratiques et de ses outils, avec une ambition claire : renforcer son impact auprès des personnes accompagnées tout en développant une culture de collaboration, de responsabilité et d’amélioration continue.Taux d’activité : 100%Type de contrat : CDIEntrée en fonction : A convenirDélai de postulation : 18\.12\.2026Le ou la directeur\-trice général\-e est nommé\-e par le Conseil d’administration de l’Hospice général.Si vous êtes intéressé.e par cette opportunité professionnelle et que vous répondez aux exigences du poste, vous êtes invité.e à postuler à l’adresse . Merci de bien attacher votre CV et votre lettre de motivation en un seul document PDF.En raison de l’importance stratégique de cette fonction, l’Hospice général a décidé de collaborer avec un partenaire externe spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils de cadres. M. Asseo (RaphaelAsseo@ ) et M. (AnthonyAdam@ ) de Executive se tiennent à votre disposition pour répondre à vos questions.Pour de plus amples informations sur le cabinet Executive, consultez le site Executive Search \| Senior Leadership Recruitment. Notre partenaire externe vous garantit une confidentialité absolue.![Hospice général, institution genevoise d'action sociale]()* Hospice général, institution genevoise d'action sociale  Cours de Rive 12  1204 Genève*jid3700717jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager:
description: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager: Clinical Environments / Clinical Demand / Operations Planning / GMP / External Contract Manufacturing / continuous process improvements / Purchase Orders / SAP S/4HANA and P1S / SOW / English / DeutschBackground:As part of PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, the Production Enablement function ensures that packaging operations can produce material required by Roche’s clinical trials seamlessly, on-time, and while optimizing cost/quality.Within Production Enablement the Global CMO Clinical Packaging Management team is responsible for overseeing the manufacturing outsourced portion of the Clinical Packaging portfolio. Contract Manufacturing Site Managers work closely with contract manufacturers (CMOs) worldwide, Procurement, Clinical Planning, Quality and other operations functions to develop and negotiate supply contracts and ensure product delivery from external manufacturing partners with optimal cost, quality and speed. CMO Site Managers also drive the evolution and implementation of new systems and efficient internal and external processes, in support of CMO production and the Pharma Vision to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden between 2020 and 2029.The Perfect Candidate:The ideal candidate is an agile, highly communicative pharmaceutical CMO professional manager with 5+ years of industry experience and a strong grasp of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) who can act as the single point of contact bridging internal clinical study stakeholders and external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). Thriving in fast-paced, unpredictable clinical environments, this person is flexible and reactive enough to quickly pivot and scale up CMO production capacity when patient enrollment unexpectedly spikes or quality deviations delay timelines. On a tactical level, they bring hands-on expertise in overseeing external site production, driving continuous process improvements as the portfolio evolves, and managing end-to-end documentation, specifically creating, revising, and tracking Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, and Statements of Work (SOWs) using strong proficiency in SAP S/4HANA and P1S.Tasks & Responsibilities:•You serve as the primary communication bridge between internal clinical stakeholders (such as study managers, clinical planning, and quality) and Roche’s global network of external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).•You monitor external clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production to ensure everything runs according to plan, while staying flexible and reactive enough to rapidly liaise with CMOs, secure extra capacity, and scale up supply when unexpected events occur—such as sudden spikes in patient enrollment or extended quality deviations.•You create, revise, and oversee Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs). Manage pre- and post-production orders in SAP, own the budgeting process for CMO variable costs, and review/approve CMO invoices.•You partner with Procurement to negotiate supply agreements and select external packaging vendors, while leading ongoing Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and tracking KPIs to guarantee predictable, on-time, and cost-effective delivery.•You champion internal and external process improvements as the clinical portfolio evolves, represent the CMO function in Clinical Demand & Operations Planning (CD&OP), and help define supply strategies for non-standard product supply chains.Must Haves:•You have 5+ years in the pharmaceutical industry with deep experience in contract manufacturing management or clinical drug manufacturing, backed by a strong understanding of GMP standards.•You have advanced proficiency in SAP S/4HANA and P1S to handle order management, budgeting, and invoicing accurately.•You have a BA/BS degree in a technical, business, or related field (Master’s, PMP, APICS/SCOR, or Six Sigma/Lean certifications are strong pluses).•You are fluent in English (basic German is beneficial), high cultural awareness, and schedule flexibility to collaborate seamlessly across North American (SSF, Mississauga) and European (Switzerland) time zones.Nice to haves:•You have direct experience in clinical drug manufacturing, clinical supply chains, or contract manufacturing management is strongly preferred (beyond general pharma or manufacturing experience).•You speak fluent German•You have finished a Master’s degree or any other training or certifications in PMP, Operational Excellence, Six Sigma, or Lean.•You hold APICS and/or SCOR certifications.Reference Nr.: 925409 Rolle: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager Industrie: PharmaLocation: Basel /HybridPensum: 100%Start: 01.01.2027(01.02.2027) Duration: 12 MonthsDeadline: 21/11/2026If this position has piqued your interest, please send us your complete resume. If this position does not quite match your profile and you would like to receive other positions directly, you can also send us your resume via this ad or to jobs[at]itcag[dot]com.Contact us for more information about our company, our positions, or our attractive payroll-only program: +41 41 760 77 01.About us:ITech Consult is an ISO 9001:2015-certified Swiss company with offices in Germany and Ireland. ITech Consult specializes in placing highly qualified candidates for temporary staffing in the fields of IT, life sciences, and engineering. We offer temporary staffing and payroll services. This is free of charge for our candidates, and we do not charge any additional fees for payroll services.

Store Maintenance

Communication

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %---PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %========================================================================Curious about the roles of households in the new Swiss Local Electricity Community regulation and how they evolve at the interface of politics and the energy sector? Then you've come to the right place!PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %======================================================================== **What you will be responsible for**  Since January 2026, so\-called Local Electricity Communities (LEG) enable Swiss households to buy and sell PV electricity within their neighbourhood. Whether LEGs will become established and make a substantial contribution to Switzerland's energy targets remains to be seen in the coming years. This is being investigated by the SFOE\-funded research project "LEAP" lead by the ZHAW in partnership with the University of Lausanne and Swisspower AG. The PhD position advertised focuses on the evolving roles, expectations and experiences of the key stakeholders in the LEGs (households, LEG service providers and energy suppliers), with a particular focus on the households who join an LEG.* Work towards a PhD (co\-supervised by the University of Lausanne) within the LEAP project* Plan and carry out surveys and interviews for your data collection* Analyse and present findings in the form of academic publications* Collaborate with the project team and beyond (e.g., communicating with partners, presenting research results at scientific conferences, etc.)* Provide ad hoc support to the Institute of Innovation \& Entrepreneurship in teaching (e.g. supervising student projects) or other research projects **What makes you a great fit*** You hold a an excellent Master's degree in Management, Environmental Sciences, Social Sciences, or similarly fitting field (e.g., renewable energy).* In addition to fluency in and/or French (a requirement for data collection), you have an excellent command of written and spoken English.* You have solid knowledge in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods (e.g. designing and analysing surveys or semi\-structured interviews).* You have a strong interest to do societally and scientifically relevant work.* You enjoy independence and autonomy, and can take responsibility for your own PhD thesis, as well as for the related project objectives. Nonetheless, you know the value of collaboration and are keen to contribute to the exchange of ideas and results with the project's research and practice partners.* Your have a clear and open communication style, and bring curiosity and enthusiasm to the team.* Practical experience in interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary project settings, as well as in the field of energy (particularly regarding energy communities), would be a welcome addition to your profile. **About your workplace**The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in \-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees.  We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances. **School of Management and Law**The ZHAW School of Management and Law (SML) is one of the largest business schools in Switzerland with around 9,500 students. It is the only university of applied sciences in the country that is included in renowned rankings published by the business newspaper "Financial Times" and is accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA \- labels for high quality standards in teaching, research and further education. The internationally recognized bachelor's and master's degree programs, cooperative PhD programs and the numerous continuing education offerings are scientifically sound, interdisciplinary and practice oriented. The SML maintains numerous collaborations with over 190 selected partner universities worldwide.The conducts research, teaches and provides consultancy in the key areas of business innovation, innovation systems and entrepreneurship. One of our key areas of focus is the transformation of the energy system, in close collaboration with various stakeholders at the interface of research, politics and society.  **Any questions? omnichannel marketing, and position Wegovy® pill, We-govy® injection and future obesity assets with a clear view of growth opportunities and canni-balisation risks.•    Shape lifecycle and loss-of-exclusivity strategies, anticipate competitor moves, and identify, quantify and prioritise new growth opportunities across markets, patient segments and chan-nels.•    Lead the move towards a propositions, evidence-based fore-casts and clear commercial KPIs.•    Lead, coach and develop a high-performing marketing team, with clear accountability and a culture grounded in patient safety, scientific integrity and measurable business impact.Who you’ll work withYou will lead the Obesity Commercial and Brand Marketing team in IOSO, part of International Operations, where colleagues work description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%--- Software Test Engineer 80–100%================================About machineMD---------------At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non\-invasive neuro\-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.The Role--------You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.* **Pragmatic Improvements** – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.* **Automation Across the System** – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end\-to\-end scenarios beyond UI testing.* **Test Infrastructure** – build on and improve our physical and software\-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.* **Coordination \& Code Quality** – work hands\-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.* **Verification \& Validation** – contribute to V\&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.What We Look For----------------### Experience* Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well\-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.* Experience with some of our core technologies ( , C\#/.NET, C\+\+ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.* Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code.* Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.### Qualifications* Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.* Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.* Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1\); or French language skills are a plus for on\-site collaboration.How You Work------------* **Systems Thinker** – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.* **Curiosity \& a Detective’s Instinct** – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.* **Close the Gaps** – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand.* **Collaborative Spirit** – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.* **Shaper Mentality \& Growth Mindset** – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real\-world use cases.Working at machineMD--------------------* Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on\-site (approximately four days a week at full\-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day.* Collaborative, in\-person working, with flexibility to do your best work.Our Four Pillars of Integrity guide how we work together:* Radical Responsibility: Own our choices.* Feeling Our Feelings: Name and honour our emotions.* Candor: Speak and listen with honesty.* Clear Agreements: Make and keep clear commitments.Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

title: Lead Data Scientist

company's broader digital transformation goals.The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with strong people leadership, and can operate comfortably across cutting-edge GenAI innovation, disciplined ML engineering, and domain-specific applications in energy, HVAC, and data center environments.**How you will do it**Strategic Leadership- Define and execute the multi-year AI/ML roadmap AI, edge AI) and their business applications.- Establish governance frameworks covering responsible AI, model risk management, data privacy, and regulatory compliance.- Manage vendor relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, tooling), and build-vs-buy decisions.GenAI & Agentic Platform- Lead the design and scaling of an enterprise agentic AI platform (LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, pricing, churn, service optimization, predictive maintenance).- Ensure rigor in model development — experimental design, validation, explainability, and measurable business KPIs.- Partner with business unit leaders to prioritize a portfolio of high-ROI analytics use cases.Data Center AI for HVAC Business- Lead AI/ML initiatives focused on data center development and operations — thermal management, cooling optimization, energy efficiency, capacity planning, and predictive insights for HVAC systems.- Work closely with HVAC product, engineering, and field teams to translate sensor/telemetry data (BMS, IoT, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units) into actionable intelligence and product features.- Develop digital twin, anomaly detection, and optimization models that improve PUE, uptime, and equipment lifecycle for data center customers.People & Organizational Leadership- Hire, mentor, and grow POD leads and a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, GenAI engineers, and MLOps engineers.- Foster a culture of experimentation, engineering excellence, and business accountability.- Define career paths, performance standards, and knowledge-sharing practices across PODs.**What we look for**Required- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (PhD a plus).- 12+ years of experience in data science / machine learning, with 5+ years in senior leadership managing multiple teams or PODs.- Domain experience in HVAC, data centers, energy management, building automation, or industrial IoT.- Proven track record of delivering production-grade AI/ML systems at enterprise scale.- Hands-on familiarity with the modern GenAI stack: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source), RAG, vector databases, agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), and evaluation/guardrail tooling.- Strong grounding in MLOps/AIOps practices and cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP), containerization, and CI/CD for ML.- Solid foundation in classical statistics and ML (regression, time series, classification, optimization) and their application to business problems.- Demonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders, translate ambiguous problems into AI solutions, and communicate impact to executives.- Experience managing budgets, vendors, and cross-functional programs.Preferred - Familiarity with time-series/telemetry data at scale, digital twins, physics-informed ML, or reinforcement learning for control/optimization (e.g., cooling optimization).- Experience with edge AI deployment and BMS/SCADA integration.- Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, model governance, and relevant regulations.- Publications, patents, or recognized contributions in AI/ML.Key Competencies- Strategic thinking with hands-on technical depth.- Multi-team leadership and talent development.- Executive communication and stakeholder management.- Bias for action and outcome-driven delivery.- Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-evolving AI landscape.**About Us **Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.
